"""Selected original scientific-report editions and their typed source history.

The report identity, order and bytes are retained. This resolver never renders a
report, rewrites its original Workspace path, or materializes source-view links.
The maintained source-lineage resolvers decide which editable studies accompany
each exact source collection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier, read_json
from . import observed_context

KIND = "scientific-report-editions"
SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-report-edition/v1"
RECEIPT_SCHEMA = "upstate.study-scientific-report-edition/v1"
ROOT_KINDS = (KIND,)
DOCUMENTS = {KIND: "edition.json"}
LOCKS = {KIND: ".observed-report.lock"}
LABELS = {KIND: "Saved scientific reports"}


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("A saved scientific report needs an original relative member path.")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or ".." in path.parts
            or path.as_posix() != value or any(":" in part for part in path.parts)):
        raise ValueError("A saved scientific report member must remain in its original directory.")
    return value


def _source(closure, choice, expected_source):
    """Validate a source binding through CAS objects without creating view links."""
    collection_id = identifier(choice["source_collection_id"])
    value = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(value) != collection_id:
        raise ValueError("A scientific report's original source collection changed.")
    entries = [entry for entry in value.get("entries", [])
               if entry.get("id") == choice["source_id"]]
    if len(entries) != 1 or entries[0].get("kind") != "document":
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report needs its exact original source document.")
    entry = entries[0]
    original_source = {
        **choice, "title": entry["title"], "vintage": entry["vintage"],
        "uri": entry["uri"], "body_bytes": entry["body"]["bytes"],
        "body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
    }
    if any(expected_source.get(name) != value for name, value in original_source.items()):
        raise ValueError("The saved report source roster differs from its original source edition.")
    members = {}
    for item in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("A scientific report source repeats an original member path.")
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
        members[name] = item
    recipe = closure.read(entry["body"]["object"])
    if recipe.get("schema") != observed_context.SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("The original scientific report document has another schema.")
    for item in recipe.get("inputs", []):
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        original = members.get(name)
        if original is None or any(original.get(field) != item.get(field)
                                   for field in ("bytes", "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("The scientific report lost an original source input: " + name)
    closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Ordered scientific report source " + entry["id"])
    if getattr(closure, "implementation_lineage_enabled", True):
        from . import implementation_report_transfer
        implementation_report_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    captured_sources = getattr(closure, "report_source_keys", None)
    if captured_sources is not None and (collection_id, entry["id"]) not in captured_sources:
        # Earlier archives retain the ordered source bytes without later-added
        # editable producer records. Reopen precisely that captured dependency set.
        return {
            "schema": "upstate.observed-report-binding/v1", "edition": observed_context.EDITION,
            "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
            "body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
            "member_sha256": {name: members[name]["sha256"] for name in sorted(members)},
        }
    # These producer contracts apply only to explicitly ordered saved-edition
    # sources. Older archive selections keep their original dependency semantics.
    from . import monitoring_study_transfer, study_report_transfer, receiving_water_report_transfer
    from . import native_process_study_transfer
    from . import ensemble_study_transfer, gauge_study_transfer
    monitoring_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    study_report_transfer.include_calibration(closure, collection_id, entry)
    receiving_water_report_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    native_process_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    from . import published_review_study_transfer
    published_review_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    ensemble_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    from . import paired_ensemble_study_transfer
    paired_ensemble_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    gauge_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    from . import community_study_transfer, conservation_study_transfer
    community_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    conservation_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    from . import receptor_study_transfer
    receptor_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    from . import landcover_study_transfer
    landcover_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    from . import chemistry_study_transfer
    chemistry_study_transfer.include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)
    return {
        "schema": "upstate.observed-report-binding/v1", "edition": observed_context.EDITION,
        "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
        "body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
        "member_sha256": {name: members[name]["sha256"] for name in sorted(members)},
    }


def _record(workspace, key, record):
    identifier(key)
    identity = record.get("render_identity")
    if (record.get("schema") != SCHEMA or record.get("id") != key
            or record.get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or not isinstance(identity, dict) or digest(identity) != key
            or identity.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-report-native/v1"
            or record.get("state") != "complete"
            or record.get("operation_id") != "observed-report-" + key[:20]):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report differs from its original completed edition.")
    return identity


def include(closure, key, record):
    """Retain one completed original edition and its ordered source dependencies."""
    identity = _record(closure.workspace, key, record)
    prefix = KIND + "/" + key + "/"
    result = closure.read(prefix + "operation.json")
    selection_record = closure.read(prefix + "selection.json")
    if (selection_record != identity or result.get("state") != "complete"
            or result.get("operation_id") != record["operation_id"]
            or any(result.get(name) != value for name, value in identity.items())
            or any(record.get(name) != result.get(name) for name in
                   ("state", "operation_id", "source_count", "section_count",
                    "figure_count", "sources", "files"))):
        raise ValueError("The completed scientific report differs from its retained edition.")
    selection = identity.get("selection")
    if not isinstance(selection, dict):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report needs its original ordered selection.")
    choices = observed_context.source_choices(selection)
    if not choices or len(choices) != record.get("source_count"):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report changed its ordered source count.")
    sources = record.get("sources")
    if (not isinstance(sources, list) or
            [{name: row.get(name) for name in ("source_collection_id", "source_id")}
             for row in sources] != choices):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report changed its ordered source roster.")
    bindings = [_source(closure, choice, source) for choice, source in zip(choices, sources)]
    binding = observed_context._binding([{"binding": item} for item in bindings])
    if identity.get("binding") != binding or selection.get("observed_context_binding") != binding:
        raise ValueError("The scientific report source bindings differ from the saved edition.")
    files = record.get("files")
    if not isinstance(files, dict) or not files:
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report has no retained output files.")
    if any(role in files for role in ("operation", "edition")):
        raise ValueError("A saved scientific report uses a reserved output role.")
    retained = {}

    def member(name, expected=None):
        name = _relative(name)
        relative = prefix + name
        closure.add_file(relative, expected)
        previous = retained.get(relative)
        if previous is not None and expected is not None and any(
                previous.get(field) != expected.get(field) for field in ("bytes", "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("Scientific report roles disagree about an original output.")
        item = closure.files[relative]
        if item.get("sha256") is None:
            closure.read(relative)
            item = closure.files[relative]
        retained[relative] = {"path": relative, "bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]}

    for descriptor in files.values():
        if not isinstance(descriptor, dict):
            raise ValueError("A scientific report output needs its original file descriptor.")
        member(descriptor["path"], descriptor)
    for name in ("edition.json", "operation.json", "selection.json"):
        member(name)
    if (files.get("selection") or {}).get("path") != "selection.json":
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report lacks its original selection artifact.")

    archive = None
    receipt_name = prefix + "report-files.json"
    if (closure.root / receipt_name).exists() or (closure.root / receipt_name).is_symlink():
        archived = closure.read(receipt_name)
        expected_members = {}
        for descriptor in files.values():
            name = _relative(descriptor["path"])
            expected_members[name] = {field: descriptor[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}
        for name in ("edition.json", "operation.json"):
            expected_members[name] = {field: retained[prefix + name][field]
                                      for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}
        descriptor = archived.get("file")
        if (archived.get("members") != expected_members or not isinstance(descriptor, dict)
                or descriptor.get("path") != "report-files.zip"):
            raise ValueError("The saved report ZIP differs from its original report files.")
        member("report-files.json")
        member("report-files.zip", descriptor)
        archive = deepcopy(retained[prefix + "report-files.zip"])
    retained_row = {
        "schema": RECEIPT_SCHEMA, "id": key, "project_id": closure.workspace.project["id"],
        "operation_id": record["operation_id"], "title": record["title"],
        "record_sha256": retained[prefix + "edition.json"]["sha256"],
        "operation_sha256": retained[prefix + "operation.json"]["sha256"],
        "render_identity_sha256": digest(identity),
        "source_choices": deepcopy(choices), "sources": deepcopy(sources),
        "source_binding": deepcopy(binding),
        "source_count": record["source_count"], "section_count": record["section_count"],
        "figure_count": record["figure_count"],
        "members": [retained[name] for name in sorted(retained)],
        "report_archive": archive,
    }
    previous = closure.scientific_report_records.get(key)
    if previous is not None and previous != retained_row:
        raise ValueError("The selected scientific report changed during transfer preparation.")
    closure.scientific_report_records[key] = retained_row
    closure.nodes[(KIND, key)].update(
        title=record["title"], state="complete", source_count=record["source_count"],
        section_count=record["section_count"], figure_count=record["figure_count"],
        ordered_source_choices=deepcopy(choices),
    )


def visit(closure, kind, key, value):
    if kind != KIND:
        return False
    include(closure, key, value)
    return True


def receipt(closure):
    return [deepcopy(row) for unused, row in sorted(closure.scientific_report_records.items())]


def verify_receipt(closure, captured):
    """Check retained bytes while permitting later report ZIP creation."""
    actual = {row["id"]: row for row in receipt(closure)}
    for original in captured:
        current = actual.get(original["id"])
        if current is None or any(
                current.get(name) != value for name, value in original.items()
                if name not in ("members", "report_archive")):
            raise ValueError("The received study lost an original scientific report edition.")
        members = {row["path"]: row for row in current["members"]}
        if any(members.get(row["path"]) != row for row in original["members"]):
            raise ValueError("The received scientific report lost an exact original output file.")
        if original.get("report_archive") is not None and current.get("report_archive") != original["report_archive"]:
            raise ValueError("The received scientific report lost its retained report ZIP.")


def catalogue(workspace):
    """Read saved edition metadata; preview validates the selected complete files."""
    root = Path(workspace.root).resolve()
    rows = []
    for path in sorted((root / KIND).glob("*/edition.json")):
        key = path.parent.name
        try:
            identifier(key)
            if path.is_symlink() or path.parent.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
                raise ValueError("Keep the saved scientific edition inside its original Workspace.")
            record = read_json(path)
            identity = _record(workspace, key, record)
            row = {"kind": KIND, "id": key, "title": record["title"], "state": "complete",
                   "updated_at": "", "selection": deepcopy(identity["selection"]),
                   "counts": {name: record[name] for name in
                              ("source_count", "section_count", "figure_count")}}
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            row = {"kind": KIND, "id": key, "title": key[:12], "state": "unreadable",
                   "updated_at": "", "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}}
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
files.model/receptor_study_transfer.py:
"""Editable original watershed network, preparation and native programme lineage.

Reads declared records and CAS members only. Scientific quantities, geographic
membership, model execution and report production remain with their original
owners. This helper extends the maintained selected-study closure.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier, read_json

ROOT_KINDS = ("receptor-networks", "receptor-scenario-areas", "receptor-programmes",
              "receptor-experiments", "receptor-inventories", "receptor-report-sources")
DOCUMENTS = {kind: "result.json" for kind in ROOT_KINDS}
DOCUMENTS["compute-programmes"] = "programme.json"
LOCKS = dict(zip(ROOT_KINDS, (".network.lock", ".prepare.lock", ".prepare.lock",
                            ".batch.lock", ".inventory.lock", ".report.lock")))
LOCKS["compute-programmes"] = ".programme.lock"
LABELS = dict(zip(ROOT_KINDS, ("Original watershed networks", "Prepared source-water areas",
                              "Source-water native programmes", "Source-water experiment comparisons",
                              "Native receiving-area inventories", "Source geography report sources")))
SCHEMAS = dict(zip(ROOT_KINDS, (
    "upstate.receptor-network-product/v1", "upstate.receptor-scenario-areas/v1",
    "upstate.receptor-programme/v1", "upstate.receptor-experiment/v1",
    "upstate.receptor-inventory/v1", "upstate.receptor-report-source/v1")))
REPORT_SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-report/v1"
SOURCE_SCOPE = "Original watershed topology and prepared source geometry"


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("Retain the original watershed member path")
    name = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (not name.parts or name.is_absolute() or ".." in name.parts
            or name.as_posix() != value or any(":" in part for part in name.parts)):
        raise ValueError("A watershed member must remain in its original directory")
    return value


def _prefix(kind, key):
    return kind + "/" + identifier(key) + "/"


def _same(first, second):
    return isinstance(first, dict) and isinstance(second, dict) and all(
        field in first and first[field] == second.get(field) for field in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _files(closure, prefix, files):
    if not isinstance(files, dict):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original watershed file inventory")
    for item in files.values():
        closure.add_file(prefix + _relative(item["path"]), item)


def _read_file(closure, prefix, item):
    path = prefix + _relative(item["path"])
    closure.add_file(path, item)
    return closure.read(path)


def _record(closure, kind, key):
    return closure.read(_prefix(kind, key) + DOCUMENTS[kind])


def _identity(closure, kind, key, value):
    identity = value.get("identity")
    legacy = kind == "receptor-experiments" and identity is None
    if (value.get("schema") != SCHEMAS[kind] or value.get("id") != key
            or not legacy and (not isinstance(identity, dict) or digest(identity) != key)):
        raise ValueError("The original watershed record changed its retained identity")
    if kind not in ("receptor-networks", "receptor-inventories"):
        if value.get("workspace_id") != closure.workspace.project["id"]:
            raise ValueError("The watershed continuation belongs to another original project")
        if (identity or {}).get("workspace_id") not in (None, closure.workspace.project["id"]):
            raise ValueError("The watershed identity belongs to another original project")
    prefix = _prefix(kind, key)
    closure.tree(prefix.rstrip("/"))
    _files(closure, prefix, value["files"])
    return prefix


def _source(closure, collection_id, source_id, *, body=None):
    collection_id = identifier(collection_id)
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
    if collection.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(collection) != collection_id:
        raise ValueError("The original watershed source collection changed")
    rows = [row for row in collection.get("entries", []) if row.get("id") == source_id]
    if len(rows) != 1 or body is not None and not _same(rows[0]["body"], body):
        raise ValueError("The watershed source differs from its retained original body")
    closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Original source-water input edition")
    return rows[0]


def _network(closure, key, value, prefix):
    identity, binding = value["identity"], value["source_binding"]
    if (identity.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-networks"]
            or identity.get("source_body_sha256") != binding.get("body_sha256")
            or not _same(value["files"]["source_body"],
                         {"bytes": binding.get("body_bytes"), "sha256": binding.get("body_sha256")})
            or _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["profile"]) != identity.get("receptor_spec")):
        raise ValueError("The watershed network lost its original source or receiving-area specification")
    network = _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["network"])
    if (network.get("source_binding") != binding
            or network.get("network_huc12_count") != value.get("network_huc12_count")
            or network.get("selected_huc12_count") != value.get("selected_huc12_count")
            or network.get("shared_huc12s") != value.get("shared_huc12s")
            or [{k: v for k, v in area.items() if k != "memberships"}
                for area in network.get("areas", [])] != value.get("areas")):
        raise ValueError("The retained network summary differs from its original drainage inventory")
    closure._source_refs(identity["receptor_spec"], "Original watershed source reference")


def _prepared(closure, key, value, prefix):
    identity = value["identity"]
    network_id = identifier(value["network_result_id"])
    network = _record(closure, "receptor-networks", network_id)
    if (identity.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-scenario-areas"]
            or identity.get("network_result_id") != network_id
            or identity.get("source_body_sha256") != network["source_binding"]["body_sha256"]
            or value.get("source_binding") != network["source_binding"]):
        raise ValueError("Prepared polygons differ from their original watershed source")
    closure.need("receptor-networks", network_id, "Original network behind prepared source polygons")
    if _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["network"]) != _read_file(
            closure, _prefix("receptor-networks", network_id), network["files"]["network"]):
        raise ValueError("Prepared source areas changed their retained drainage graph")
    areas = value.get("areas")
    if (not isinstance(areas, list) or [area.get("id") for area in areas] != identity.get("receptor_ids")):
        raise ValueError("Prepared source areas changed their original ordered selection")
    for area in areas:
        entry = _source(closure, value["source_collection_id"], area["source_id"],
                        body=value["files"][area["file_key"]])
        origin = entry.get("origin") or {}
        if (entry.get("kind") != "vector" or entry.get("source_plan_id") != key
                or origin.get("network_result_id") != network_id
                or origin.get("receptor_id") != area["id"]
                or origin.get("huc12s") != area["huc12s"]
                or origin.get("original_source_body_sha256") != value["source_binding"]["body_sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("A prepared original polygon source lost its native watershed binding")
    handoff = _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["handoff"])
    if handoff != value.get("scenario_source_areas"):
        raise ValueError("The prepared original analysis handoff changed")
    origin = handoff.get("origin") or {}
    if (origin.get("workspace_id") != closure.workspace.project["id"]
            or origin.get("source_plan_id") != key
            or origin.get("network_result_id") != network_id
            or origin.get("source_collection_id") != value["source_collection_id"]):
        raise ValueError("The prepared source handoff belongs to another original selection")


def _programme(closure, key, value, prefix):
    identity, selection = value["identity"], value["selection"]
    prepared_id = identifier(value["preparation_id"])
    prepared = _record(closure, "receptor-scenario-areas", prepared_id)
    if (identity.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-programmes"]
            or identity.get("selection") != selection
            or selection.get("preparation_id") != prepared_id
            or value.get("network_result_id") != prepared["network_result_id"]
            or value.get("source_collection_id") != prepared["source_collection_id"]
            or value.get("source_binding") != prepared["source_binding"]
            or identity.get("source_body_sha256") != prepared["source_binding"]["body_sha256"]
            or identity.get("source_collection_id") != prepared["source_collection_id"]
            or [row.get("run_id") for row in value["runs"]] != identity.get("native_run_ids")
            or _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["selection"]) != selection
            or _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["comparison"]) != value["comparison_selection"]):
        raise ValueError("The source-water programme changed its original prepared-area binding")
    closure.need("receptor-scenario-areas", prepared_id, "Original source-water programme polygons")
    closure.need("grids", selection["grid_id"], "Original source-water native grid")
    closure.need("experiments", value["experiment_id"], "Original paired source-water experiment")
    closure.need("compute-programmes", value["programme_id"], "Original native execution continuation")
    native = _record(closure, "compute-programmes", value["programme_id"])
    if (native.get("selection", {}).get("source_reference") != "upstate.experiment:" + value["experiment_id"]
            or {row["run_id"] for row in native.get("runs", [])} != set(identity["native_run_ids"])):
        raise ValueError("The execution programme changed its original paired run roster")
    for row in value["runs"]:
        closure.need("runs", row["run_id"], "Original prepared source-water native case")
        closure.need("runs", row["paired_baseline_run_id"], "Original paired source-water baseline")
    for kind, field in (("profiles", "profile_ids"), ("scenarios", "scenario_ids")):
        for item in selection[field]:
            closure.need(kind, item, "Original source-water design selection")
    closure.need("scenarios", selection["baseline_scenario_id"], "Original land-cover baseline")


def _compute(closure, key, value):
    from .compute_programme import ComputeProgrammes
    # Both original checks are pure dictionary validation; do not call status(),
    # inspect_execution(), or any native programme writer during closure.
    owner = ComputeProgrammes(closure.workspace)
    owner._check_record(key, value)
    prefix = _prefix("compute-programmes", key)
    closure.tree(prefix.rstrip("/"))
    state = closure.read(prefix + "progress.json")
    owner._check_state(key, state)
    closure.need("grids", value["selection"]["grid_id"], "Original execution-programme grid")
    for row in value["runs"]:
        if digest(row["native_selection"]) != row["run_id"]:
            raise ValueError("The retained programme case changed its original native selection")
        closure.need("runs", row["run_id"], "Original execution-programme case")
        retained = closure.read("runs/" + row["run_id"] + "/run.json")
        if retained.get("selection") != row["native_selection"]:
            raise ValueError("The programme case differs from its original native run")
        for donor in (row.get("source_runs") or {}).values():
            closure.need("runs", donor, "Original producing-stage donor for the retained programme")
    for comparison in state.get("comparisons", {}).values():
        if comparison.get("id"):
            closure.need("comparisons", comparison["id"], "Original programme comparison")
    for delivery in state.get("deliveries", {}).values():
        if delivery.get("delivery_id"):
            closure.need("deliveries", delivery["delivery_id"], "Original programme map delivery")
        if delivery.get("receiving"):
            closure._descriptors(delivery["receiving"])
    for continuation in state.get("pair_completions", {}).values():
        closure.need("compute-programmes", continuation["programme_id"],
                     "Original matched-pair native continuation")
        closure._descriptors(continuation["origin"])
    # Reports and attempts are retained under the original programme tree.
    # Their native dependencies remain the exact immutable case roster above.


def _inventory(closure, key, value, prefix):
    selection = value.get("build_selection")
    if not isinstance(selection, dict) or value["identity"].get("selection") != selection:
        raise ValueError("The receiving-area inventory changed its original native selection")
    closure.need("runs", selection["baseline_run_id"], "Original receiving-area baseline")
    for run_id in selection["scenario_run_ids"]:
        closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original receiving-area land-cover alternative")
    if selection.get("delivery_id"):
        closure.need("deliveries", selection["delivery_id"], "Original receiving-area priority map")
    closure._source_refs(selection["receptor_spec"], "Original receiving-area input geography")
    inventory = _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["inventory"])
    if (inventory.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-inventories"]
            or inventory.get("baseline_run_id") != value.get("baseline_run_id")
            or inventory.get("alternative_run_ids") != value.get("alternative_run_ids")
            or inventory.get("native_execution") != value.get("native_execution")):
        raise ValueError("The native receiving-area inventory differs from its retained result")


def _experiment(closure, key, value, prefix):
    identity, selected = value.get("identity"), value["selection"]
    if (identity is not None and identity.get("selection") != selected
            or selected.get("experiment_id") != value.get("experiment_id")):
        raise ValueError("The receiving-area comparison changed its original experiment")
    closure.need("experiments", value["experiment_id"], "Original receiving-area parameter experiment")
    if value.get("grid_id"):
        closure.need("grids", value["grid_id"], "Original receiving-area comparison grid")
    snapshot = _read_file(closure, prefix, value["files"]["snapshot"])
    if snapshot.get("id") != value["experiment_id"] or value["files"]["snapshot"]["sha256"] != value["snapshot_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The receiving-area experiment lost its retained case snapshot")
    closure._source_refs(selected["receptor_spec"], "Original receiving-area comparison sources")
    for baseline, delivery_id in selected.get("delivery_ids_by_baseline", {}).items():
        closure.need("runs", baseline, "Original receiving-area priority baseline")
        closure.need("deliveries", delivery_id, "Original receiving-area priority delivery")
    for group in value["groups"]:
        if group.get("state") == "complete":
            closure.need("receptor-inventories", group["inventory_id"], "Original completed receiving-area profile result")
            closure._descriptors(group["files"])
            closure.need("runs", group["baseline_run_id"], "Original profile baseline")
            for run_id in group["alternative_run_ids"]:
                closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original profile alternative")


def _report(closure, key, value, prefix):
    identity = value["identity"]
    if (identity.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-report-sources"]
            or value.get("selection") != identity.get("selection")
            or value.get("network_result_id") != identity["selection"].get("network_id")
            or value.get("preparation_id") != identity["selection"].get("preparation_id")
            or value.get("state") != "complete"):
        raise ValueError("Choose the original completed source geography report")
    network_id = identifier(value["network_result_id"])
    closure.need("receptor-networks", network_id, "Original source geography report network")
    closure.add_file(_prefix("receptor-networks", network_id) + "result.json", identity["network_result"])
    prepared_id = value.get("preparation_id")
    if prepared_id:
        closure.need("receptor-scenario-areas", prepared_id, "Original source geography report polygons")
        closure.add_file(_prefix("receptor-scenario-areas", prepared_id) + "result.json", identity["prepared_result"])
    for name, descriptor in identity["source_members"].items():
        closure.add_file(prefix + _relative(name), descriptor)
    choice = value["source_choice"]
    entry = _source(closure, choice["source_collection_id"], choice["source_id"], body=value["files"]["recipe"])
    include_source(closure, choice["source_collection_id"], entry)


def visit(closure, kind, key, value, reason=None):
    if kind == "compute-programmes":
        _compute(closure, key, value)
        return True
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        return False
    prefix = _identity(closure, kind, key, value)
    {"receptor-networks": _network, "receptor-scenario-areas": _prepared,
     "receptor-programmes": _programme, "receptor-experiments": _experiment,
     "receptor-inventories": _inventory, "receptor-report-sources": _report}[kind](closure, key, value, prefix)
    return True


def _cas(closure, descriptor):
    closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
    return closure.read(descriptor["object"])


def _companions(closure, entry):
    result = {}
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in result:
            raise ValueError("The source geography report repeats a companion path")
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
        result[name] = item
    return result


def _entry_identity(entry):
    return {
        "id": entry["id"], "kind": entry["kind"], "uri": entry["uri"],
        "metadata": entry.get("metadata", {}),
        "body": {name: entry["body"][name] for name in ("bytes", "sha256")},
        "companions": {item.get("view_path", item["filename"]):
                       {name: item[name] for name in ("bytes", "sha256")}
                       for item in entry.get("companions", [])},
    }


def _map_members(closure, identity, recipe, members, product, prepared, summary):
    """Validate the original R9 map capture without loading a GIS renderer."""
    selected = identity["selection"]
    version = identity.get("version")
    if version == 1:
        if (selected.get("include_maps", False) or "native_map_runtime" in identity
                or "figure_spec" in recipe or "figures" in recipe
                or "projected_maps" in summary):
            raise ValueError("The original source report acquired another map edition")
        return set()
    runtime = identity.get("native_map_runtime")
    if (version != 2 or selected.get("include_maps") is not True
            or not isinstance(runtime, dict)
            or runtime.get("schema") != "upstate.receptor-map-runtime/v1"):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original declared source-map rendering edition")
    inventory_name = "figures/source-water-map-members.json"
    specification_name = "figures/source-water-map-spec.json"
    reader_name = "figures/original-geometry-reader.json"
    inventory = _cas(closure, members[inventory_name])
    chosen = set((prepared or {}).get("identity", {}).get(
        "receptor_ids", [area["id"] for area in product["areas"]]))
    ordered = [area["id"] for area in product["areas"] if area["id"] in chosen]
    expected_identity = {"network_id": product["id"],
                         "preparation_id": (prepared or {}).get("id"),
                         "receptor_ids": ordered,
                         "source_binding": product["source_binding"], "runtime": runtime}
    if (not ordered or len(ordered) != len(chosen)
            or inventory.get("schema") != "upstate.receptor-report-maps/v1"
            or inventory.get("identity") != expected_identity
            or inventory.get("figure_spec") != specification_name
            or recipe.get("figure_spec") != specification_name
            or summary.get("projected_maps") != inventory.get("summary")):
        raise ValueError("The saved projected maps differ from their original selected source areas")
    mapped = {}
    for item in inventory["files"]:
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        if name in mapped or name not in members or not _same(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("A retained projected-map companion changed")
        mapped[name] = item
    figures = inventory["figures"]
    if (not isinstance(figures, list) or not figures
            or recipe.get("figures") != [{key: item[key] for key in ("id", "path")}
                                         for item in figures]):
        raise ValueError("The saved report changed its ordered original map figures")
    source_names = set()
    for descriptor in runtime["source"]:
        name = "render-source/" + _relative(descriptor["path"])
        if name in source_names or name not in mapped or not _same(descriptor, mapped[name]):
            raise ValueError("The map capture lost its original renderer source")
        source_names.add(name)
    figure_names, figure_ids = set(), set()
    for figure in figures:
        name = _relative(figure["path"])
        if (not isinstance(figure["id"], str) or not figure["id"]
                or figure["id"] in figure_ids or name in figure_names
                or name != "figures/" + figure["id"] + ".svg"):
            raise ValueError("The saved map repeats or changes an original figure identity")
        figure_names.add(name)
        figure_ids.add(figure["id"])
    expected = source_names | figure_names | {specification_name, reader_name}
    if set(mapped) != expected or inventory_name in expected:
        raise ValueError("The source-map inventory is not the complete original rendering capture")
    specification = _cas(closure, members[specification_name])
    if (specification.get("schema") != "upstate.scientific-figure-spec/v1"
            or specification.get("edition") != "source-water-original-maps/1"
            or specification.get("rendering") != {
                "reportlab_version": runtime["libraries"]["reportlab"], "width_points": 511.2}
            or [(item["id"], item["title"], item["caption"])
                for item in specification.get("figures", [])] != [
                    (item["id"], item["title"], item["caption"]) for item in figures]):
        raise ValueError("The retained map specification differs from its original figure inventory")
    source = product["files"]["source_body"]
    original = {"path": "network/" + source["path"],
                "bytes": source["bytes"], "sha256": source["sha256"]}
    reader = _cas(closure, members[reader_name])
    if (reader.get("schema") != "upstate.receptor-map-original-reader/v1"
            or reader.get("original_source") != original
            or reader.get("source_binding") != product["source_binding"]
            or reader.get("runtime") != runtime):
        raise ValueError("The saved geometry interpretation lost its original source and runtime")
    return expected | {inventory_name}


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    """Follow only the declared original geography producer of a saved edition."""
    metadata = entry.get("metadata") or {}
    if metadata.get("source_scope") != SOURCE_SCOPE:
        return False
    recipe = _cas(closure, entry["body"])
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or metadata.get("report_schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA
            or recipe.get("schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA or recipe.get("source_scope") != SOURCE_SCOPE):
        raise ValueError("Source geography report differs from its declared original producer")
    members = _companions(closure, entry)
    inputs = recipe.get("inputs")
    if not isinstance(inputs, list):
        raise ValueError("The source geography report lost its original declared inputs")
    requested = {}
    for item in inputs:
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        if name in requested or name not in members or not _same(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("A source geography input differs from its original companion")
        requested[name] = item
    if set(requested) | {"index.html"} != set(members) or "index.html" in requested:
        raise ValueError("The source geography report changed its complete original companion set")
    provenance = _cas(closure, members["provenance.json"])
    identity = provenance.get("identity")
    if not isinstance(identity, dict):
        raise ValueError("The source geography report lost its original identity")
    key = identifier(provenance.get("report_id"))
    selected = identity.get("selection") or {}
    network_id = identifier(selected.get("network_id"))
    prepared_id = selected.get("preparation_id")
    if prepared_id is not None:
        prepared_id = identifier(prepared_id)
    project = identity.get("workspace_id")
    if (provenance.get("schema") != "upstate.receptor-report-provenance/v1"
            or identity.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-report-sources"]
            or identity.get("version") not in (1, 2) or digest(identity) != key
            or not isinstance(project, str) or not project
            or entry.get("id") != "source-water-geography-" + key[:24]
            or entry.get("uri") != "urn:sha256:" + key
            or recipe.get("title") != selected.get("title")
            or provenance.get("network_id") != network_id
            or provenance.get("preparation_id") != prepared_id
            or metadata.get("network_result_id") != network_id
            or metadata.get("preparation_id") != prepared_id):
        raise ValueError("The source geography report changed its original selection")
    originals = identity.get("source_members")
    if not isinstance(originals, dict) or not set(originals) <= set(requested) - {"summary.json", "provenance.json"}:
        raise ValueError("The source geography report lost its exact original product inventory")
    for name, item in originals.items():
        if not _same(item, members[name]):
            raise ValueError("A source geography product member differs from the frozen original")
    if (not _same(identity["network_result"], members["network/result.json"])
            or (prepared_id is None) != (identity.get("prepared_result") is None)
            or prepared_id is not None and not _same(
                identity["prepared_result"], members.get("prepared/result.json"))):
        raise ValueError("The source geography report lost its exact original product records")
    network = _cas(closure, members["network/result.json"])
    if (network.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-networks"] or network.get("id") != network_id
            or digest(network.get("identity")) != network_id
            or network.get("source_binding") != provenance.get("original_source_binding")):
        raise ValueError("The captured original watershed network changed")
    prepared = _cas(closure, members["prepared/result.json"]) if prepared_id else None
    if prepared is not None and (
            prepared.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-scenario-areas"]
            or prepared.get("id") != prepared_id or digest(prepared.get("identity")) != prepared_id
            or prepared.get("workspace_id") != project
            or prepared.get("network_result_id") != network_id
            or prepared.get("source_binding") != network["source_binding"]):
        raise ValueError("The captured prepared areas differ from their original network")
    expected_members = set()
    for prefix, original in [("network", network)] + ([("prepared", prepared)] if prepared else []):
        expected_members.add(prefix + "/result.json")
        for item in original["files"].values():
            name = prefix + "/" + _relative(item["path"])
            if name not in members or not _same(item, members[name]):
                raise ValueError("The source report lost an original product member: " + name)
            expected_members.add(name)
    if expected_members != set(originals):
        raise ValueError("The source report's original product inventory changed")
    summary = _cas(closure, members["summary.json"])
    if (summary.get("schema") != "upstate.receptor-report-summary/v1"
            or summary.get("network_id") != network_id
            or summary.get("preparation_id") != prepared_id
            or summary.get("original_source_binding") != network["source_binding"]):
        raise ValueError("The retained source geography summary names another original network")
    map_members = _map_members(closure, identity, recipe, members, network, prepared, summary)
    if set(requested) != set(originals) | map_members | {"summary.json", "provenance.json"}:
        raise ValueError("The source geography report changed its complete original input inventory")
    same_project = project == closure.workspace.project["id"]
    # Earlier selected-source archives retained the complete capture without
    # editable producer roots. Preserve their source-only reading behavior.
    local = same_project and (closure.root / "receptor-report-sources" / key).exists()
    required = []
    capture_sha = None
    original_choice = None
    if local:
        closure.need("receptor-report-sources", key, "Original editable source geography report")
        record_path = _prefix("receptor-report-sources", key) + "result.json"
        captured = closure.read(record_path)
        if (captured.get("schema") != SCHEMAS["receptor-report-sources"]
                or captured.get("id") != key or captured.get("identity") != identity
                or captured.get("workspace_id") != project or captured.get("state") != "complete"
                or captured.get("summary") != summary or captured.get("selection") != selected):
            raise ValueError("The selected report differs from its original saved producer")
        original_choice = captured["source_choice"]
        original_entry = _source(closure, original_choice["source_collection_id"],
                                 original_choice["source_id"], body=entry["body"])
        if _entry_identity(original_entry) != _entry_identity(entry):
            raise ValueError("The selected report is not an equivalent original source reimport")
        prefix = _prefix("receptor-report-sources", key)
        _files(closure, prefix, captured["files"])
        if (not _same(captured["files"]["recipe"], entry["body"])
                or _read_file(closure, prefix, captured["files"]["recipe"]) != recipe
                or _read_file(closure, prefix, captured["files"]["provenance"]) != provenance):
            raise ValueError("The selected source recipe differs from its original report capture")
        for name, descriptor in members.items():
            closure.add_file(prefix + name, descriptor)
        for kind, original in [("receptor-networks", network)] + (
                [("receptor-scenario-areas", prepared)] if prepared else []):
            closure.need(kind, original["id"], "Original editable source geography")
            if _record(closure, kind, original["id"]) != original:
                raise ValueError("The frozen report and editable original geography differ")
            required.append({"kind": kind, "id": original["id"]})
        required.append({"kind": "receptor-report-sources", "id": key})
        capture_sha = closure.files[record_path]["sha256"]
    binding = {
        "schema": "upstate.study-report-lineage/v1",
        "report_context_kind": "receptor-source-geography",
        "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
        "source_body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"], "source_project_id": project,
        "report_source_id": key, "network_result_id": network_id, "preparation_id": prepared_id,
        "capture_record_sha256": capture_sha, "capture_source": original_choice,
        "relationship": ("same_project" if local else "source_only" if same_project else "external_project"),
        "required_records": required,
    }
    token = (collection_id, entry["id"])
    previous = closure.report_source_records.get(token)
    if previous is not None and previous != binding:
        raise ValueError("The source geography binding changed during study selection")
    closure.report_source_records[token] = binding
    return True


def _candidates(closure, kind):
    folder = closure.root / kind
    if not folder.exists():
        return
    if folder.is_symlink() or not folder.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("The retained watershed collection is not an original directory")
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("*/" + DOCUMENTS[kind])):
        try:
            identifier(path.parent.name)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if path.is_symlink() or path.parent.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("The retained watershed record contains a nonportable alias")
        try:
            value = read_json(path)
            if not isinstance(value, dict):
                raise ValueError("The original watershed record is unreadable")
        except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
            closure.related_issues.append({"path": path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix(),
                                           "message": str(error)})
            continue
        yield path.parent.name, value


def related(closure):
    """Add original receiving-area continuations only to explicitly related exports."""
    networks = {key for kind, key in closure.nodes if kind == "receptor-networks"}
    prepared = {key for kind, key in closure.nodes if kind == "receptor-scenario-areas"}
    experiments = {key for kind, key in closure.nodes if kind == "experiments"}
    runs = {key for kind, key in closure.nodes if kind == "runs"}
    rules = (
        ("receptor-scenario-areas", lambda row: row.get("network_result_id") in networks),
        ("receptor-report-sources", lambda row: row.get("network_result_id") in networks
         and (row.get("preparation_id") is None or row.get("preparation_id") in prepared)),
        ("receptor-programmes", lambda row: row.get("preparation_id") in prepared),
        ("receptor-experiments", lambda row: row.get("experiment_id") in experiments),
        ("receptor-inventories", lambda row: row.get("baseline_run_id") in runs
         and bool(row.get("alternative_run_ids"))
         and set(row["alternative_run_ids"]).issubset(runs)),
    )
    for kind, selected in rules:
        for key, row in _candidates(closure, kind):
            if selected(row):
                closure.need(kind, key, "Related original source-water continuation")
    # This field is written by receptor_scenarios.save_scenario, not inferred
    # from arbitrary scenario labels, geometries or free-form metadata.
    folder = closure.root / "scenarios"
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("*.json")):
        try:
            key = identifier(path.stem)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("The retained scenario contains a nonportable alias")
        try:
            value = read_json(path)
            source = value.get("source_area_selection") or {}
            if not isinstance(source, dict):
                raise ValueError("The original scenario source-area selection is unreadable")
        except (ValueError, AttributeError, OSError) as error:
            closure.related_issues.append({"path": path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix(),
                                           "message": str(error)})
            continue
        if source.get("preparation_id") in prepared:
            closure.need("scenarios", key, "Original land-cover design from the selected source areas")


def lock_paths(closure):
    result = set()
    for kind, key in closure.nodes:
        if kind in LOCKS:
            result.add(_prefix(kind, key) + LOCKS[kind])
        if kind == "compute-programmes":
            result.update(_prefix(kind, key) + name for name in (".execution.lock", ".control.lock"))
    return sorted(result)


def catalogue(workspace, kind):
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        return []
    root = Path(workspace.root).resolve()
    folder = root / kind
    if folder.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("The source-water catalogue leaves its original workspace")
    result = []
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("*/result.json")):
        key = path.parent.name
        try:
            identifier(key)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        row = {"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": key[:12], "state": "unreadable",
               "updated_at": ""}
        try:
            if path.is_symlink() or path.parent.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("The source-water catalogue record contains an alias")
            record = read_json(path)
            if record.get("schema") != SCHEMAS[kind] or record.get("id") != key:
                raise ValueError("The source-water catalogue record changed its identity")
            row.update(title=record.get("title") or key[:12],
                       state=record.get("state") or "complete",
                       updated_at=record.get("updated_at") or record.get("created_at") or "",
                       counts=record.get("counts"))
        except Exception as error:
            row["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
        result.append(row)
    return result

def verify_received(workspace, report_id=None):
    """Reopen retained editable products after the normal selected Study restore."""
    from .common import read_json
    from . import receptor_report_source, receptor_scenarios, study_transfer

    if report_id is not None:
        report_id = identifier(report_id)
    studies = study_transfer.verify_received_studies(workspace)
    rows = []
    seen = set()
    for study in studies:
        receipt = read_json(workspace.root / "study-transfers" / (study["id"] + ".json"))
        for binding in receipt["identity"].get("scientific_report_sources", []):
            if binding.get("report_context_kind") != "receptor-source-geography":
                continue
            key = identifier(binding["report_source_id"])
            if report_id is not None and key != report_id:
                continue
            token = (study["id"], binding["source_collection_id"], binding["source_id"])
            if token in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(token)
            row = {"study_id": study["id"], "report_id": key,
                   "relationship": binding["relationship"],
                   "editable_products": (binding["relationship"] == "same_project"),
                   "source_collection_id": binding["source_collection_id"],
                   "source_id": binding["source_id"],
                   "network_result_id": binding["network_result_id"],
                   "preparation_id": binding["preparation_id"],
                   "identity": "MATCH"}
            if (binding["relationship"] == "same_project"):
                result = receptor_report_source.inspect(workspace, key)
                _, network, _ = receptor_scenarios._network(workspace, binding["network_result_id"])
                preparation = (receptor_scenarios.inspect(workspace, binding["preparation_id"])
                               if binding["preparation_id"] is not None else None)
                row.update(source_choice=result["source_choice"],
                           original_source_binding=network["source_binding"],
                           prepared_source_collection_id=(preparation["source_collection_id"]
                                                          if preparation else None),
                           areas=[{"id": area["id"], "huc12_count": area["huc12_count"]}
                                  for area in (preparation or network)["areas"]])
            rows.append(row)
    if report_id is not None and not rows:
        raise ValueError("No retained typed source-water Study receipt selects that report")
    return {"schema": "upstate.source-water-study-receiving/v1",
            "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "workspace": str(workspace.root),
            "studies": studies, "source_water_reports": rows}


def main(argv=None):
    import argparse
    import json
    from .workspace import Workspace

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, help="Normally restored selected Study Workspace")
    parser.add_argument("--report-id", help="Require this exact retained source-water report")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(verify_received(Workspace(args.workspace), args.report_id),
                     indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Transfer an editable source-water study

The existing **Source-water areas** desk now offers **Transfer editable study** for each saved original watershed network, prepared source area, source-water programme, experiment comparison, receiving-area inventory, and scientific geography report source. The action rereads the exact saved record in its original Workspace, then opens the maintained selected-study desk. Its normal preview shows the native records and complete files before the existing export queue creates the portable archive.

The complete source-results ZIP remains available for reading and GIS reuse. Editable Study transfer additionally retains the original Workspace records and native dependencies needed to reopen and continue the scientific work.

## What travels

| Saved selection | Original editable continuation |
| --- | --- |
| Watershed network | Exact retained source body, original profile and drainage links, HUC12 memberships, geographic view, and original source references |
| Prepared source areas | Original network, ordered receiving areas, unchanged polygon sources, source collection, and original scenario-area handoff |
| Source-water programme | Prepared areas, original grid/profiles/scenarios, the paired experiment, original compute-programme selection/progress, and exact native run identities |
| Experiment comparison | Original experiment and complete retained case snapshot, completed receiving-area inventories, native run cohort, original GIS products and producing-model provenance |
| Receiving-area inventory | Original baseline and alternatives, original geography sources, native grid and profiles, and any selected native map delivery |
| Scientific geography report source | Original recipe and all unchanged companions, frozen network/preparation product records, original source capture, and editable same-project source records |

The original compute-programme continuation retains its read-only validated programme and progress records, completed comparisons, delivery references, source-stage donor runs, and saved matched-pair child programmes. A received programme continues through the existing native programme controller. Transfer does not prepare a new model run, recalculate quantities, infer a profile, or change the original run state.

When **Include related results** is enabled in the selected-study desk, the closure also follows saved preparations belonging to the chosen network; saved land-cover scenarios and source-water programmes belonging to those preparations; and source-water comparisons and inventories whose original experiment or complete native run cohort is already selected. The preview names the added records. Disable the option for only the requested records and their required dependencies.

## Saved scientific report editions

A source geography report is recognized by its explicit original source scope, report schema, source ID and URI, and its frozen provenance record. The transfer helper compares every declared recipe input and original companion against the retained CAS bytes. It also verifies the captured network and optional prepared-area result records and their complete product inventories.

For a source from the same original project, the saved edition follows those original editable records and the original producer source collection. An equivalent reimport in another source collection is accepted only when its body, companion paths, byte counts, hashes, URI and producer metadata match. A report from a different original project remains a complete self-contained source package; its foreign IDs are not looked up as local scientific records.

This join is called only by the maintained saved scientific-report edition resolver. Ordinary source imports retain their existing dependency policy.

## Restore and continue

Use the existing selected-study export, transfer or original portable restore. After restore, open **Source-water areas** to inspect the saved network, prepared areas, programme and result inventory. Prepared areas still open their original scenario tools; a source-water programme still opens its exact native programme; saved comparisons retain their original case snapshot and GIS files.

Original `.network.lock`, `.prepare.lock`, `.batch.lock`, `.inventory.lock` and `.report.lock` boundaries are used during capture. Compute-programme capture also observes the original programme, execution and control locks. File contents and directory inventories are checked by the maintained Study transfer writer. Reading the closure does not materialize source views or rewrite report records.

The retained network describes original upstream HUC12 relationships. It does not imply that a geography-only report contains modeled pollutant quantities. Physical inventories continue to identify their original baseline, alternatives, grid support, annual units and producing model versions.

## Saved projected-map editions

Original R8 reports retain their complete source geography. R9 reports with maps additionally retain the original projected SVG figures, figure specification, geometry-reader inventory and the exact renderer source bytes. The transfer checks the version 2 identity, original native runtime declaration, selected network and prepared areas, ordered figures and every map companion against the original saved capture. Receiving reads those artifacts without re-rendering the maps or requiring the former GIS runtime to be installed. The editable original records keep their source identities.

The common report-source receipt limits restored archives to the editable source histories originally captured for each source pair. An older archive can therefore reopen its retained ordered report and companion bytes without unexpectedly requiring later-added producer records. A new explicit selection follows the complete current typed source history.

## Component integration

The additive helper is `model/receptor_study_transfer.py`. Its public contract is:

- `ROOT_KINDS`, `DOCUMENTS`, `LOCKS` and `LABELS` extend the original selected-study catalogue and record resolver.
- `visit(closure, kind, key, value, reason=None)` validates the six original source-water record families and the original `compute-programmes` continuation.
- `related(closure)` follows only explicit native source-water relationships when related results are requested.
- `lock_paths(closure)` returns the original relative lock paths.
- `catalogue(workspace, kind)` lists saved records without creating native state.
- `include_source(closure, collection_id, entry)` verifies the original declared scientific geography source and records its binding through the existing report-source receipt.

The original native owners remain authoritative: `receptor_network_cli`, `receptor_scenarios`, `receptor_programmes`, `receptor_experiments`, `receptor_cli`, `receptor_report_source`, and `ComputeProgrammes`. The helper uses only their retained contracts and the original pure programme record/state validators.

The component fragment keeps the Receptors, native programme and Study transfer modules together in a cold application. The maintained source installer admits these files as an optional layer and checks the original dependencies when the shared core imports the helper. It preserves the existing mandatory Decision package and all previous preimage guards.

## Verification

The exact current original Receptor controller was executed in V8 with its transport and document interface stubbed. All six saved-result kinds handed the exact server-returned ID and title to the original selected-study desk. Checks covered a Workspace A → B → A change, detach while reading, repeated clicks, mismatched returned identity, and absent host capability. This is controller execution, not a browser or native scientific run. Actual receiving uses the existing authorized source-water operation and original export/restore queue.

## Open the original received study

In the receiving Workspace, open **Study transfer**. The saved-study catalogue and **Included scientific records** preview show **Open in Source-water areas** beside the original source-water records. The action opens the existing Source-water areas desk and the exact selected result. Its original maps, data downloads, scientific source controls and editable selection remain available in that desk.

| Selected record | Original desk result |
| --- | --- |
| Original watershed network | Network, retained HUC12 geometry and upstream memberships |
| Prepared source-water areas | Original source-area preparation and saved scenario controls |
| Source-water native programme | Retained programme and original native case progression |
| Source-water experiment comparison | Original profile comparison and producing-run context |
| Native receiving-area inventory | Saved inventory and contributing-area quantities |
| Source geography report | Original captured scientific source, maps and complete files |

Opening a record preserves the existing workspace draft. **Use this saved selection** is the explicit action for adopting a saved selection into that draft. The opening control waits for the original desk catalogue and validates the returned record ID, type and workspace. Moving to another workspace, closing the desk or choosing another result invalidates an older in-flight opening request.

# Customer review of a saved scientific report

A completed scientific report can enter the existing Customer review workflow with its original HTML, PDF, data, figures, source records and rendering identity. The review uses a retained source collection, so the existing review package, responses, worklist, reconciliation and complete Workspace transfer continue to apply.

The source edition stays fixed throughout review. The operator chooses the review title, purpose, questions and notes. Creating the review does not rerender the scientific report or replace the underlying measurements.

## Operator workflow

1. In Retained source reports, choose Open saved report for an existing completed edition.
2. Choose Prepare customer review. The existing editor opens as Review saved scientific report and fixes its selected source to that exact edition.
3. Enter Review title and Purpose. Add explicit review requirements and Notes as needed.
4. Choose Retain review. The operator verifies the exact edition and complete member inventory, then queues review creation with the normalized current fields, preview operation ID and task's original creation timestamp. Editing the fields during verification asks you to submit those current fields again.
5. Choose Open retained review from the completed task. In Files, the original scientific report appears above its full file inventory. Choose Read original PDF to read the complete compiled report, or Download original PDF to retain that file. Export complete review (also available as Export current review) prepares the full reviewer package with the linked HTML, figures, data and exact response history.
6. Use Receive response for the actual returned feedback. Current requests keeps questions, requested changes and the existing engineering response/reconciliation workflow available.

A source change or an edited review draft requires a fresh preview. An interrupted queued request uses its original task identity and creation time; it reuses the same retained source and review edition.

## Original report and source contract

The shared model/scientific_report_editions.py verifier reads:

- scientific-report-editions/EDITION_ID/edition.json
- scientific-report-editions/EDITION_ID/operation.json
- scientific-report-editions/EDITION_ID/selection.json
- every original descriptor in the saved report's files inventory.

The edition ID must match the digest of its original render identity. The completed operation, saved selection, full file inventory and current bound original study sources must agree. Every selected file is checked against its retained byte count and SHA256.

The adapter retains one source entry:

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Native manifest schema | upstate.sources/v1 |
| Entry kind | document |
| Role | SCIENTIFIC_REPORT_REVIEW |
| Primary body | The actual original report_html member |
| Companions | All remaining original report members, plus edition.json and operation.json |
| Source URI | urn:upstate:scientific-report:PROJECT_ID:EDITION_ID |
| Metadata | Complete original edition identity, render identity, ordered observed-source binding and report counts |

The copied report tree is unchanged. Its HTML can still resolve its original figures and linked data within the source view and exported review package. The compiled source has schema upstate.scientific-report-edition/v1 in its metadata; it is not registered as another observed-report recipe.

The underlying original observed studies keep their separate source collection/document identities. The compiled report source records those exact ordered bindings.

The Customer review report card identifies the compiled PDF through the declared original `report.pdf` member, its source part, artifact identity and authenticated download ticket. PDFs embedded in the original studies remain in the complete file inventory and are not substituted for the compiled report. The card shows the retained report title and available study/figure counts; its saved-edition identity and PDF checksum remain available in details.

## Backend API

The additive adapter is model/scientific_report_review.py. Both functions accept an existing Workspace object or its original path.

~~~python
preview = preview_review(workspace, edition_id, review_selection)

result = create_review(
    workspace,
    edition_id,
    review_selection,
    expected_operation_id=preview["operation_id"],
    created_at=original_task_created_at,
)
~~~

The review_selection argument contains only:

~~~json
{
  "title": "Review of the selected scientific report",
  "purpose": "Review the original methods, findings and source support for the stated project purpose.",
  "requirements": [
    {
      "id": "methods",
      "title": "Methods and interpretation",
      "detail": "Identify any requested clarification to the methods or interpretation."
    }
  ],
  "notes": []
}
~~~

These are editable review questions. They do not constitute a response or approval.

preview_review returns the normalized review_selection, operation_id, actual scientific_report_edition_id, original report title, source_identity, original_study_count, section_count, figure_count, sources, primary_path, member_count, total bytes and complete member descriptors.

create_review verifies the preview again, imports or reopens the original compiled-report source, then calls the existing reviews.create_review with the real source_collection_id and original task timestamp. It reopens the result through reviews.show_review to check every artifact.

Its result contains:

- review_id and scientific_report_edition_id.
- operation_id, actual created_at, title and purpose.
- Actual source_collection_id and source_id.
- The full source_identity and actual native review_selection.
- artifact_count, source_member_count and original_study_count.
- source_directory and a source_receipt descriptor relative to the original Workspace.

The existing native review selection remains upstate.customer-review-selection/v1. Its source_collection_ids list contains the actual imported compiled-report collection. No new review-selection kind is introduced.

## Original source retention and retries

Source copies live under:

~~~text
scientific-report-reviews/SOURCE_IDENTITY_DIGEST/source/
    report/
        report.html
        report.pdf
        original report data, figures and source-member trees
        edition.json
        operation.json
        selection.json
    model-sources.json
    source-receipt.json
~~~

The source identity binds the original project, edition, complete render identity, primary HTML path and every member's original bytes/hash. Source creation has its own lock. An existing source receipt is reused only after verifying the original copied files, imported source collection, complete relative tree and body identity.

Reviews retain the source through the ordinary native source collection. Offline export therefore includes the exact HTML and all companion files beside it. Existing review receiving and Workspace backup/restore preserve the ordinary source objects and review records.

## CLI

Use the current complete application and an existing saved scientific edition. The review selection JSON is the explicit document shown above.

~~~sh
python -B -m model.scientific_report_review \
  --workspace /path/to/original-workspace \
  --edition-id ORIGINAL_SAVED_EDITION_ID \
  --review-selection review-selection.json \
  --preview
~~~

Then use the actual returned preview operation ID and one retained creation timestamp:

~~~sh
python -B -m model.scientific_report_review \
  --workspace /path/to/original-workspace \
  --edition-id ORIGINAL_SAVED_EDITION_ID \
  --review-selection review-selection.json \
  --expected-operation-id RETURNED_PREVIEW_OPERATION_ID \
  --created-at ORIGINAL_REVIEW_CREATION_TIMESTAMP
~~~

For a retry, keep the same timestamp and original review selection. A new intended review round can use a new retained creation time while reusing the same original compiled-report source.

The resulting review_id is the existing Customer review ID. Its ordinary show, export, receive-response and worklist operations apply without another report engine.

## Related maintained code

- model/scientific_report_editions.py — shared original saved-edition inspection.
- operator/source_report_editions.py — queued scientific rendering and saved-edition interface.
- model/reviews.py — review selection, artifacts, export, responses and receiving.
- model/review_worklist.py — current returned requests and engineering responses.
- model/portable.py — complete original Workspace backup and receiving.


## Transfer the editable review with its scientific report

In **Customer reviews**, open the saved review and choose **Transfer editable
review**. The existing Study transfer desk receives that exact saved review.
Preview its original dependencies, then use the original queued Study export.
Restore the resulting archive into a new directory through the ordinary
Workspace restore flow and open **Customer reviews** in the received project.

The selected transfer retains the original review title, purpose, requirements,
notes and complete selected artifacts. It also retains the complete native
customer response chain, item decisions, questions, requested changes, correction
assignments and resolutions. Engineering handbacks carry their original response,
previous handback and explicitly selected revised review; their selected original
and revised scientific records travel together. These remain the maintained
review records, not a copied parallel store.

A selected saved scientific report also includes its linked Customer reviews
when **Include related results** is enabled. This association requires the
original `SCIENTIFIC_REPORT_REVIEW` source identity, project and saved edition.
Imported reports from another project retain their captured source files without
resolving the other project's producer IDs locally. Turning related results off
leaves the report selection narrower; explicitly selecting a Customer review
always includes the dependencies required to reopen that review.

Received review-package receipts carry the unchanged original ZIP in the
Workspace's content-addressed objects. Returned response documents retain their
complete original JSON bytes, including staged returns awaiting reconciliation.
Prepared and completed reconciliation records keep the actual choices, candidate,
predecessor, operation identity and resulting response. An interrupted prepared
reconciliation remains prepared; transfer never silently imports or resolves it.

After receiving, append responses, reconcile an independently returned response,
or prepare a further engineering handback through the same original controls.
Receiving verification requires the transferred response prefix and every
captured immutable member. New replies and later completed reconciliations may
extend that history without invalidating the original transfer.

The native report HTML/PDF, linked figures/data and original report source
receipt retain their paths and hashes. The original source files behind mixed
review selections, completed runs, map exports and deliveries are included by
the existing typed scientific dependency closure. Historical local browser-view
caches and sender-local operator export directories are recreated through their
original controls on the receiving computer; they are not substituted for the
retained original review archive, source records or feedback.

Implementation: `model/customer_review_study_transfer.py` composes the original
`model.reviews`, `review_handback`, `review_receiving` and
`review_reconciliation` validators. Source resolution reads existing CAS members
without creating source-view links. The original Workspace and reconciliation
locks protect capture. No native model or report rendering is run during transfer.
