def _hash(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _path(root, name):
    path = root / name
    for item in (path, *path.parents):
        if item.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Source path contains an alias: " + str(item))
        if item == root:
            break
    return path


def _read(root, name, *, required=True):
    path = _path(root, name)
    if not path.exists():
        if required:
            raise ValueError("Receive the complete source dependency: " + name)
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode):
        raise ValueError("Source must be a regular file: " + name)
    return path.read_bytes()


def _directory_literal(source, variable, *, directories, function=None):
    """Extend one current string inventory; preserve its type and other source."""
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    scope = tree
    if function:
        matches = [node for node in tree.body
                   if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
                   and node.name == function]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Compose the current source collector: " + function)
        scope = matches[0]
    assignments = []
    for node in scope.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            targets = node.targets
        elif isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign):
            targets = [node.target]
        else:
            continue
        if any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == variable for target in targets):
            assignments.append(node.value)
    if len(assignments) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Compose the unique current directory inventory: " + variable)
    value = assignments[0]
    if not isinstance(value, (ast.Tuple, ast.List, ast.Set)):
        raise ValueError("The current source inventory must remain a literal: " + variable)
    selected = ast.literal_eval(value)
    if isinstance(value, ast.Set):
        selected = sorted(selected)
    if not all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in selected):
        raise ValueError("The source directory inventory needs original directory names")
    additions = [*selected, *(name for name in directories if name not in selected)]
    if list(selected) == additions:
        return source
    if isinstance(value, ast.Set):
        literal = "{" + ", ".join(repr(name) for name in additions) + "}"
    else:
        literal = repr(tuple(additions) if isinstance(value, ast.Tuple) else additions)
    replacement = literal.encode("utf-8")
    lines = source.encode("utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
    start = sum(map(len, lines[:value.lineno - 1])) + value.col_offset
    end = sum(map(len, lines[:value.end_lineno - 1])) + value.end_col_offset
    body = source.encode("utf-8")
    result = (body[:start] + replacement + body[end:]).decode("utf-8")
    ast.parse(result)
    return result


def _assembler_directories(source, directories):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    collectors = [node for node in tree.body
                  if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "_source_inventory"]
    if len(collectors) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Compose the current installed-source collector")
    declarations = [node.value for node in collectors[0].body
                    if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
                    and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "roots"
                            for target in node.targets)]
    if len(declarations) == 1:
        value = declarations[0]
        if (isinstance(value, ast.Call) and isinstance(value.func, ast.Name)
                and value.func.id == "_installed_source_directories"):
            resolvers = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
                         and node.name == "_installed_source_directories"]
            if (len(resolvers) != 1 or not any(isinstance(node, ast.Constant)
                    and node.value == "APPLICATION_DIRECTORIES" for node in ast.walk(resolvers[0]))):
                raise ValueError("Verify the current assembler's portable-inventory resolver")
            # The maintained current resolver reads the installed portable source.
            # Extending that actual declaration already extends its snapshot roots.
            return source
    return _directory_literal(source, "roots", directories=directories,
                              function="_source_inventory")


def inventory_sources(sources, *, directories=(DIRECTORY,)):
    """Extend original collectors for the explicitly received source namespaces."""
    if not isinstance(directories, (tuple, list)) or not directories:
        raise ValueError("Choose the complete received application source directories")
    if any(not isinstance(name, str) or not name or name.startswith(".")
           or "/" in name or "\\" in name or "\0" in name for name in directories):
        raise ValueError("Each application source directory must be one ordinary root name")
    directories = tuple(dict.fromkeys(directories))
    if "model/portable.py" not in sources:
        raise ValueError("Receive the current scientific Workspace portable module")
    result = {"model/portable.py": _directory_literal(
        sources["model/portable.py"], "APPLICATION_DIRECTORIES", directories=directories)}
    if ASSEMBLER in sources:
        result[ASSEMBLER] = _assembler_directories(sources[ASSEMBLER], directories)
    if DIRECTORY in directories and DATABASE_MODULE in sources:
        result[DATABASE_MODULE] = _directory_literal(
            sources[DATABASE_MODULE], "MUTABLE_DATABASE_MEMBERS",
            directories=(DATABASE_MEMBER,))
    return result


def restore_sources(sources):
    """Join original design validators to the current provider without replacing its edits."""
    descriptor_name = "operator/extensions/conservation-design.json"
    provider_name = "operator/conservation_design.py"
    descriptor = json.loads(sources[descriptor_name])
    backend = descriptor.get("backend", {})
    if backend.get("verify_workspace"):
        return {}
    if backend.get("module") != "conservation_design":
        raise ValueError("Compose the current Scenario design provider registration")
    factory = backend.get("factory", {})
    if not isinstance(factory, dict) or not isinstance(factory.get("handler"), str):
        raise ValueError("Receive the original Scenario design provider factory")
    text = sources[provider_name]
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    classes = [node for node in tree.body
               if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == factory["handler"]]
    if len(classes) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Compose the actual Scenario design provider factory")
    provider = classes[0]
    if any(isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
           and node.name == "verify_workspace" for node in provider.body):
        raise ValueError("Register the original provider's existing workspace verifier")
    method = '''
    def verify_workspace(self, workspace):
        """Reopen the original retained designs after portable receiving."""
        from model import conservation_design as original_design
        summary = original_design.overview(workspace)
        preparations = [original_design.get_preparation(workspace, row["id"])
                        for row in summary["preparations"]]
        receivings = [original_design.get_receiving(workspace, row["id"])
                     for row in summary["receivings"]]
        return {
            "conservation_design_preparations": [row["id"] for row in preparations],
            "conservation_design_receivings": [row["id"] for row in receivings],
            "verified_count": len(preparations) + len(receivings),
        }
'''
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    position = sum(map(len, lines[:provider.end_lineno]))
    joined = text[:position].rstrip("\r\n") + "\n" + method + text[position:]
    compile(joined, provider_name, "exec")
    backend["verify_workspace"] = {"handler": "verify_workspace", "args": ["workspace"]}
    return {provider_name: joined,
            descriptor_name: json.dumps(descriptor, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"}


def _validate_sources(incoming):
    for name, data in incoming.items():
        if name.endswith(".py"):
            compile(data.decode("utf-8"), name, "exec")
    descriptor = json.loads(incoming["operator/extensions/conservation-design.json"])
    if (descriptor.get("schema") != "upstate.operator-extension/v1"
            or descriptor.get("id") != "conservation-design"
            or descriptor.get("backend", {}).get("module") != "conservation_design"):
        raise ValueError("Receive the original Scenario design extension descriptor")
    backend = descriptor.get("backend", {})
    if not {"conservation.design.editor.open", "conservation.design.editor.write"}.issubset(backend.get("actions", ())):
        raise ValueError("Receive the complete embedded-editor action registration")
    if "conservation_design_editor.mjs" not in descriptor.get("assets", ()):
        raise ValueError("Receive the embedded-editor parent browser asset registration")
    if not any(route.get("path") == "/api/conservation-design/editor"
               and "POST" in route.get("methods", ()) for route in backend.get("routes", ())):
        raise ValueError("Receive the original embedded-editor read route")
    if not any(route.get("path") == "/api/file/conservation-design/{workspace_key}/editor/{member_path...}"
               and route.get("response") == "ticket_policy_pair"
               for route in backend.get("file_routes", ())):
        raise ValueError("Receive the original embedded-editor authenticated file transport")
    manifest = json.loads(incoming["scenario-design/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json"])
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or not manifest:
        raise ValueError("Receive the complete original editor source manifest")
    expected = {name.removeprefix(DIRECTORY + "/") for name in incoming
                if name.startswith(DIRECTORY + "/")
                and name != "scenario-design/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json"}
    if set(manifest) != expected:
        raise ValueError("The editor manifest and complete source inventory differ")
    for name, record in manifest.items():
        body = incoming[DIRECTORY + "/" + name]
        if record.get("bytes") != len(body) or record.get("sha256") != _hash(body):
            raise ValueError("Editor source differs from its original manifest: " + name)


def _atomic(path, data, mode):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pending = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, prefix=".design-install-", delete=False) as stream:
            pending = Path(stream.name)
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.chmod(pending, mode)
        os.replace(pending, path)
        pending = None
    finally:
        if pending is not None:
            pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def install(application, source, *, preview=False):
    """Compose, validate and install the complete component in the current application."""
    application, source = Path(application).absolute(), Path(source).absolute()
    for root in (application, source):
        for item in (root, *root.parents):
            if item.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("Choose an ordinary application/source directory")
        if not root.is_dir():
            raise ValueError("Choose an existing application/source directory")
    dependencies = {name: _read(application, name) for name in DEPENDENCIES}
    current = {name: _read(application, name) for name in SHARED}
    assembler = _read(application, ASSEMBLER, required=False)
    if assembler is not None:
        current[ASSEMBLER] = assembler
    incoming = {name: _read(source, name) for name in FILES}
    scenario_tree = ast.parse(incoming["model/conservation_scenarios.py"].decode("utf-8"))
    scenario_methods = {node.name for node in scenario_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}
    if not {"_effective_run", "_validate_run"}.issubset(scenario_methods):
        raise ValueError("Receive the current original conservation_scenarios.py with native model-scope resolution")
    _validate_sources(incoming)
    database_tree = ast.parse(current[DATABASE_MODULE].decode("utf-8"))
    database_methods = {node.name for node in database_tree.body
                        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}
    if not {"snapshot_databases", "without_database_files", "verify_database_sources"}.issubset(database_methods):
        raise ValueError("Receive the maintained SQLite online-backup source before installing the embedded editor")
    portable_tree = ast.parse(current["model/portable.py"].decode("utf-8"))
    if not any(isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
               and node.func.id == "snapshot_databases" for node in ast.walk(portable_tree)):
        raise ValueError("Receive the maintained Workspace archive with its original SQLite snapshot integration")
    study_tree = ast.parse(dependencies["model/study_transfer.py"].decode("utf-8"))
    design_aliases = {
        item.asname or item.name
        for node in study_tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 1 and node.module is None
        for item in node.names if item.name == "conservation_design_study_transfer"
    }
    design_calls = {
        node.func.attr for node in ast.walk(study_tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
        and isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name)
        and node.func.value.id in design_aliases
    }
    if not {"source_snapshot", "capture", "verify"}.issubset(design_calls):
        raise ValueError(
            "Receive the maintained Study transfer editor snapshot, capture and receiving join "
            "before installing this complete selected-study component")
    backups = [node for node in portable_tree.body
               if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "backup"]
    if len(backups) != 1 or "frozen_databases" not in {
            arg.arg for arg in [*backups[0].args.args, *backups[0].args.kwonlyargs]}:
        raise ValueError("Receive the maintained portable backup with exact frozen database support")
    host = runpy.run_path(str(application / "install_extensions.py"))
    if not all(callable(host.get(name)) for name in ("patch_server", "patch_app")):
        raise ValueError("Receive the maintained extension installer's source composition API")
    composed = inventory_sources({name: body.decode("utf-8") for name, body in current.items()})
    composed["operator/server.py"] = host["patch_server"](current["operator/server.py"].decode("utf-8"))
    composed["operator/web/app.mjs"] = host["patch_app"](current["operator/web/app.mjs"].decode("utf-8"))
    restored = restore_sources({name: incoming[name].decode("utf-8") for name in (
        "operator/conservation_design.py", "operator/extensions/conservation-design.json")})
    changes = {**incoming, **{name: body.encode("utf-8") for name, body in restored.items()},
               **{name: body.encode("utf-8") for name, body in composed.items()}}
    for name, body in changes.items():
        if name.endswith(".py"):
            compile(body.decode("utf-8"), name, "exec")
    lock = _path(application, "operator/.conservation-design-install.lock")
    fd = os.open(lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0), 0o600)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        receipt_name = "operator/conservation-design-install.json"
        previous_data = _read(application, receipt_name, required=False)
        previous = json.loads(previous_data) if previous_data else {}
        originals, modes = {}, {}
        for name, body in changes.items():
            before = _read(application, name, required=False)
            originals[name] = before
            path = _path(application, name)
            modes[name] = stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) if before is not None else (
                0o755 if name == "scenario-design/start.sh" else 0o644)
            if (name in incoming and before is not None and before != body
                    and before != incoming[name]):
                known = previous.get("installed", {}).get(name)
                if known != _hash(before) and _hash(before) not in PREDECESSORS.get(name, ()):
                    raise ValueError("Compose the independently updated component source: " + name)
            if name in current and before != current[name]:
                raise ValueError("The current source changed during composition: " + name)
        rows = [{"path": name, "before_sha256": _hash(originals[name]) if originals[name] is not None else None,
                 "sha256": _hash(body), "bytes": len(body), "changed": originals[name] != body}
                for name, body in sorted(changes.items())]
        dependency_hashes = {name: _hash(body) for name, body in dependencies.items()}
        operation_id = _hash(json.dumps({"files": rows, "dependencies": dependency_hashes},
                                       sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8"))
        result = {"schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": operation_id,
                  "application": str(application), "files": rows,
                  "dependencies": dependency_hashes,
                  "application_directories": [DIRECTORY],
                  "assembler_present": assembler is not None,
                  "assembler_updated": assembler is not None and changes[ASSEMBLER] != assembler,
                  "catalogue": "/api/conservation-design/overview",
                  "editor_database_member": DATABASE_MEMBER,
                  "editor_database_snapshot": "sqlite-online-backup",
                  "changed_files": sum(row["changed"] for row in rows)}
        if preview:
            return {**result, "state": "prepared"}
        for name, before in dependencies.items():
            if _read(application, name) != before:
                raise ValueError("A retained dependency changed during preparation: " + name)
        history = application / ".conservation-design-install-history" / operation_id
        journal = {**result, "state": "prepared",
                   "installed": {name: _hash(body) for name, body in changes.items()}}
        _atomic(history / "operation.json",
                (json.dumps(journal, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8"), 0o600)
        written = []
        try:
            for name, body in changes.items():
                before = originals[name]
                if _read(application, name, required=False) != before:
                    raise ValueError("Concurrent source changed before installation: " + name)
                if before == body:
                    continue
                if before is not None:
                    _atomic(history / name, before, modes[name])
                _atomic(_path(application, name), body, modes[name])
                written.append(name)
            for name, body in dependencies.items():
                if _read(application, name) != body:
                    raise ValueError("A retained dependency changed during installation: " + name)
            for name, body in changes.items():
                if _read(application, name) != body:
                    raise ValueError("Installed source changed before completion: " + name)
            complete = {**journal, "state": "installed"}
            _atomic(_path(application, receipt_name),
                    (json.dumps(complete, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8"), 0o644)
        except BaseException:
            # Only undo this operation's unchanged postimages; preserve newer writers.
            for name in reversed(written):
                path = _path(application, name)
                if _read(application, name, required=False) != changes[name]:
                    continue
                if originals[name] is None:
                    path.unlink()
                else:
                    _atomic(path, originals[name], modes[name])
            raise
        return {**result, "state": "installed"}
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--application", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
    parser.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        print(json.dumps(install(args.application, args.source, preview=args.preview), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, SyntaxError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"state": "failed", "type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}),
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run one conservation browser journey against the existing regional Workspace.

The existing receiving owner starts the original operator and retains its startup
JSON locally. This script reuses that operator and the regional receiver's study.
It checks two actual units, retains that cohort when the candidate catalog is
available, saves one original portfolio, reopens it after reload, and downloads
the original exported packet. An interrupted run resumes its retained task IDs.

Example:
  /opt/pyvenv/bin/python operator/conservation_browser_receiving.py \
    --operator-receipt /mnt/data/eco12-run/operator-startup.json \
    --regional-receiving WORKSPACE/conservation-receiving/regional-receiving.json \
    --output /mnt/data/eco12-run/receiving/browser-e7a1

Use --study-key protection_upstream or protection_reporting when the regional
result contains the original surface-water protection studies. The default
upstream key preserves the original geographic-context receiving journey.
Add --record-video when the installed Playwright runtime supports video.
Playwright references: https://playwright.dev/python/docs/downloads
                       https://playwright.dev/python/docs/videos
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlencode, urlsplit
import zipfile

OPERATION = "UPSTATE-FULL-PRODUCT-BUILD-BRYCE-20261012-E7A1"
SCHEMA = "upstate.conservation-browser-receiving/v1"
TITLE = "E7A1 real watershed browser receiving"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def file_record(path):
    path = Path(path)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    size = 0
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
    return {"path": str(path.resolve()), "bytes": size, "sha256": digest.hexdigest()}


def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--operator-receipt", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--regional-receiving", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--study-key", default="upstream",
                        help="Existing regional study key, including protection_upstream or protection_reporting.")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--chromium", default="/usr/bin/chromium")
    parser.add_argument("--task-timeout", type=float, default=240)
    parser.add_argument("--record-video", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(math.isfinite(args.task_timeout) and args.task_timeout > 0,
            "Use a finite positive task timeout.")
    connection = read_json(args.operator_receipt)
    regional = read_json(args.regional_receiving)
    require(regional.get("operation") == OPERATION, "Use the E7A1 regional receiving result.")
    studies = regional.get("studies", {})
    require(isinstance(studies, dict), "The regional result needs its original study records.")
    selected_study = studies.get(args.study_key)
    require(isinstance(selected_study, dict) and selected_study.get("study_id"),
            "Choose a completed original regional study key. Available keys: " +
            ", ".join(sorted(studies)))
    operator_url = connection["operator_url"]
    parsed = urlsplit(operator_url)
    require(parsed.scheme == "http" and parsed.hostname in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"),
            "Use the local original operator startup receipt.")
    capability = parse_qs(parsed.fragment).get("token", [None])[0]
    require(capability, "The local startup receipt needs its original operator capability.")
    origin = parsed.scheme + "://" + parsed.netloc
    workspace = connection["workspace_key"]
    study_id = selected_study["study_id"]
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report_path = output / "receiving.json"
    report = read_json(report_path) if report_path.exists() else {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "operation": OPERATION, "study_id": study_id,
        "workspace_key": workspace, "workspace": regional.get("workspace"),
        "regional_receiving": file_record(args.regional_receiving),
        "study_key": args.study_key, "screenshots": [], "console_errors": [],
        "page_errors": [], "task_ids": {}, "state": "ready",
    }
    require(report.get("schema") == SCHEMA and report.get("operation") == OPERATION
            and report.get("study_id") == study_id and report.get("workspace_key") == workspace,
            "Use a separate output directory for a different Workspace or study.")

    def clean(value):
        # Startup capabilities stay only in this process and the owner's local receipt.
        return str(value).replace(capability, "[private capability]")

    def persist():
        temporary = report_path.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
        temporary.write_text(clean(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)) + "\n",
                             encoding="utf-8")
        temporary.replace(report_path)

    def say():
        result = {key: report.get(key) for key in
                  ("state", "study_id", "plan_id", "packet", "video")}
        result["receiving_path"] = str(report_path)
        print(clean(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False)), flush=True)

    if report.get("state") == "complete" and report.get("packet"):
        current = file_record(report["packet"]["path"])
        require(current["bytes"] == report["packet"]["bytes"]
                and current["sha256"] == report["packet"]["sha256"],
                "The retained browser packet changed.")
        say()
        return

    action_names = {
        "catalog": "conservation.catalog.prepare",
        "catalog_selection": "conservation.catalog.select",
        "plan": None,
        "export": "conservation.export",
    }
    operations = report.setdefault("operations", {})
    require(isinstance(operations, dict), "Retain the original receiving action records.")
    for key, value in operations.items():
        expected = action_names.get(key)
        allowed = ("conservation.plan.save", "conservation.catalog.plan.save") if key == "plan" else (expected,)
        require(key in action_names and isinstance(value, dict)
                and value.get("workspace") == workspace and value.get("action") in allowed
                and isinstance(value.get("payload"), dict)
                and isinstance(value.get("operation_id"), str) and value["operation_id"].strip(),
                "The retained receiving request identifies another original operation.")

    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

    if report.get("error") or report.get("page_errors") or report.get("console_errors"):
        report.setdefault("earlier_attempts", []).append({
            key: report.get(key) for key in ("state", "error", "page_errors", "console_errors")
        })
    report["state"] = "running"
    report["page_errors"] = []
    report["console_errors"] = []
    report.pop("error", None)
    persist()
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(executable_path=args.chromium, headless=True)
        options = {"viewport": {"width": 1880, "height": 1100},
                   "accept_downloads": True, "locale": "en-US"}
        if args.record_video:
            options["record_video_dir"] = str(output / "video")
            options["record_video_size"] = {"width": 1880, "height": 1100}
        context = browser.new_context(**options)
        page = context.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(45000)
        video = page.video if args.record_video else None

        def console(message):
            if message.type == "error":
                report["console_errors"].append(clean(message.text))

        page.on("console", console)
        page.on("pageerror", lambda error: report["page_errors"].append(clean(error)))
        pending_action = {}

        def record_action(request):
            if (not pending_action or request.method != "POST"
                    or urlsplit(request.url).path != "/api/actions"):
                return
            value = request.post_data_json
            if (isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("workspace") == workspace
                    and value.get("action") == pending_action["action"]):
                require(isinstance(value.get("payload"), dict)
                        and isinstance(value.get("operation_id"), str) and value["operation_id"].strip(),
                        "The original queued action needs its complete request and operation identity.")
                operations[pending_action["key"]] = value
                persist()

        page.on("request", record_action)

        def get(path, **query):
            query.setdefault("workspace", workspace)
            response = context.request.get(origin + path + "?" + urlencode(query),
                headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + capability}, timeout=45000)
            value = response.json()
            require(response.ok, value.get("error", {}).get("message", "Operator read failed."))
            return value

        def task(task_id, expected_action, payload=None):
            deadline = time.monotonic() + args.task_timeout
            resumed = False
            while True:
                value = get("/api/task", id=task_id)
                require(value.get("id") == task_id and value.get("workspace") == workspace
                        and value.get("action") == expected_action
                        and (payload is None or value.get("payload") == payload),
                        "The retained task identifies another original Workspace action.")
                if value.get("state") == "complete":
                    return value
                if value.get("state") == "interrupted" and not resumed:
                    response = context.request.post(
                        origin + "/api/task/resume", data={"id": task_id},
                        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + capability}, timeout=45000)
                    require(response.ok, "The original interrupted task could not resume.")
                    resumed = True
                    continue
                if value.get("state") in ("failed", "cancelled", "interrupted"):
                    raise ValueError("Workspace task " + task_id + ": " +
                                     json.dumps(value.get("error") or value.get("state")))
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise TimeoutError("Workspace task remains active: " + task_id)
                time.sleep(1)

        def photograph(name):
            path = output / name
            page.screenshot(path=str(path), full_page=True, animations="disabled")
            report["screenshots"] = [item for item in report["screenshots"]
                                     if item["path"] != str(path)] + [file_record(path)]
            persist()

        def remember_response(response, expected_action, report_key):
            submitted = response.json()
            require(response.status == 202 and submitted.get("id"),
                    json.dumps(submitted.get("error") or submitted))
            require(submitted.get("action") == expected_action,
                    "The browser submitted a different Workspace action.")
            report["task_ids"][report_key] = submitted["id"]
            persist()
            return submitted["id"]

        def saved_action(expected_action, report_key):
            original = operations.get(report_key)
            if original is not None:
                require(original["action"] == expected_action,
                        "The retained request belongs to another original receiving phase.")
            existing = report["task_ids"].get(report_key)
            if not existing and original is not None:
                response = context.request.post(
                    origin + "/api/actions", data=original,
                    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + capability}, timeout=45000)
                existing = remember_response(response, expected_action, report_key)
            if existing:
                return task(existing, expected_action,
                            original["payload"] if original is not None else None)
            return None

        def action(control, expected_action, report_key):
            retained_task = saved_action(expected_action, report_key)
            if retained_task is not None:
                return retained_task
            pending_action.update(key=report_key, action=expected_action)
            try:
                with page.expect_response(lambda response:
                        urlsplit(response.url).path == "/api/actions"
                        and response.request.method == "POST"
                        and isinstance(response.request.post_data_json, dict)
                        and response.request.post_data_json.get("action") == expected_action) as pending:
                    control.click()
                response = pending.value
                require(report_key in operations,
                        "Retain the original action request before accepting its queue response.")
                task_id = remember_response(response, expected_action, report_key)
            finally:
                pending_action.clear()
            return task(task_id, expected_action, operations[report_key]["payload"])

        def open_retained_task(task_id):
            # A resumed task may already be complete without an open task dialog.
            control = page.locator('[data-action="task-open"][data-id=' +
                                   json.dumps(task_id) + "]")
            if not control.is_visible():
                page.locator('.top-actions [data-action="tasks"]').click()
            expect(control).to_be_visible()
            control.click()
            expect(page.locator("#detail-dialog[open]")).to_be_visible()

        try:
            for key, original in list(operations.items()):
                saved_action(original["action"], key)
            page.goto(operator_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
            expect(page.locator("#workspace-select")).to_have_value(workspace)
            page.locator('[data-view="conservation"]').click()
            root = page.locator("#conservation-workspace")
            expect(root).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('[data-action="conservation-open-study"][data-study-id=' +
                         json.dumps(study_id) + "]").click()
            inventory_or_prepare = page.locator(
                '.cons-candidates, [data-action="conservation-catalog-prepare"]')
            expect(inventory_or_prepare.first).to_be_visible()
            prepare_search = page.locator('[data-action="conservation-catalog-prepare"]')
            if prepare_search.is_visible():
                prepared = action(prepare_search, "conservation.catalog.prepare", "catalog")
                require(prepared["result"].get("study_id") == study_id,
                        "Candidate search preparation returned another original study.")
                opener = page.locator(
                    '#detail-dialog [data-action="conservation-open-study"][data-study-id=' +
                    json.dumps(study_id) + "]")
                expect(opener).to_be_visible()
                opener.click()
            expect(page.locator(".cons-candidates")).to_be_visible()
            state = get("/api/conservation/study", study_id=study_id)
            require(state.get("state") == "complete", "Open a completed regional candidate inventory.")
            candidates = state.get("candidates", [])
            require(len(candidates) == selected_study.get("actual_candidate_count"),
                    "The browser inventory differs from the completed regional inventory.")
            report["candidate_count"] = len(candidates)
            report["mode"] = state.get("mode")
            report["metric_state"] = state.get("metric_state")
            report["water_context"] = state.get("spec", {}).get("contexts", {}).get("drinking_water")
            photograph("01-inventory.png")

            eligible = {str(row["id"]): row for row in candidates
                        if row.get("eligible") and row.get("reporting_area_ha", 0) > 0}
            protection_ids = selected_study.get("eligible_positive_protection_overlap_huc12")
            if protection_ids is not None:
                require(isinstance(protection_ids, list),
                        "The original protection study needs its positive-overlap unit inventory.")
                positive = {str(value) for value in protection_ids}
                eligible = {key: row for key, row in eligible.items()
                            if key in positive and isinstance(row.get("source_water_fraction"), (int, float))
                            and row["source_water_fraction"] > 0}
                report["selection_context"] = "Original surface-water protection overlap"
            preferred = [str(value) for value in selected_study.get("selected_original_huc12", [])
                         if str(value) in eligible]
            ordered = list(dict.fromkeys(preferred + sorted(eligible)))
            selected = report.get("selected_ids") or ordered[:2]
            require(len(selected) == 2 and all(value in eligible for value in selected),
                    "This browser journey needs two actual eligible planning units.")
            report["selected_ids"] = selected
            report["selected_candidates"] = [eligible[value] for value in selected]
            report["regional_plan_id"] = selected_study.get("plan_id")
            persist()
            clear = page.locator('[data-action="conservation-clear-selection"]')
            if clear.is_enabled():
                clear.click()
            page.locator('[data-filter="eligibility"]').select_option("all")
            for unit_id in selected:
                page.locator('[data-filter="search"]').fill(unit_id)
                page.locator('input[data-candidate-id=' + json.dumps(unit_id) + "]").check()
            page.locator('[data-filter="search"]').fill("")
            page.locator('[data-filter="eligibility"]').select_option("selected")
            expect(page.locator(".cons-candidates input[data-candidate-id]:checked")).to_have_count(2)
            retain_control = page.locator('[data-action="conservation-select-matching"]')
            catalog_selection_id = report.get("catalog_selection_id")
            use_catalog = bool(retain_control.count()) and (
                not report["task_ids"].get("plan") or bool(catalog_selection_id))
            if use_catalog:
                retained_task = action(retain_control, "conservation.catalog.select", "catalog_selection")
                retained = retained_task["result"]
                require(retained.get("study_id") == study_id and retained.get("count") == len(selected)
                        and retained.get("selection_id"),
                        "Retain exactly the two checked original units from this study.")
                catalog_selection_id = retained["selection_id"]
                report["catalog_selection_id"] = catalog_selection_id
                report["catalog_selection"] = retained
                persist()
                if not page.locator("#detail-dialog[open]").count():
                    open_retained_task(report["task_ids"]["catalog_selection"])
                opener = page.locator(
                    '#detail-dialog [data-action="conservation-open-study"][data-study-id=' +
                    json.dumps(study_id) + "][data-selection-id=" +
                    json.dumps(catalog_selection_id) + "]")
                expect(opener).to_be_visible()
                opener.click()
                expect(page.locator(".cons-help").filter(
                    has_text="Complete retained cohort: " + catalog_selection_id)).to_be_visible()
                expect(page.locator(".cons-candidates")).to_be_visible()
                page.locator('[data-filter="eligibility"]').select_option("selected")
                expect(page.locator(".cons-candidates input[data-candidate-id]:checked")).to_have_count(2)
            photograph("02-selection.png")

            if not report["task_ids"].get("plan"):
                page.locator('[data-action="conservation-new-portfolio"]').click()
                page.locator('[data-field="plan.title"]').fill(TITLE)
                page.locator('[data-field="plan.mode"]').select_option("manual")
                page.locator('[data-field="plan.area_basis"]').select_option("whole_units")
            plan_action = "conservation.catalog.plan.save" if use_catalog else "conservation.plan.save"
            saved_task = action(page.locator('[data-action="conservation-save-plan"]'),
                                plan_action, "plan")
            plan_result = saved_task["result"].get("plan") or saved_task["result"]
            plan_id = plan_result["id"]
            report["plan_id"] = plan_id
            persist()
            if page.locator('#detail-dialog[open]').count():
                opener = page.locator('#detail-dialog [data-action="conservation-open-plan"][data-plan-id=' +
                                      json.dumps(plan_id) + "]")
                expect(opener).to_be_visible()
                opener.click()
            else:
                page.locator('[data-action="conservation-close-study"]').click()
                page.locator('[data-action="conservation-refresh"]').click()
                page.locator('[data-action="conservation-open-plan"][data-plan-id=' +
                             json.dumps(plan_id) + "]").click()
            saved = get("/api/conservation/plan", plan_id=plan_id)
            require(sorted(saved["selected_ids"]) == sorted(selected),
                    "The saved portfolio differs from the checked native units.")
            if use_catalog:
                cohort = saved.get("selection", {}).get("catalog_selection", {})
                require(cohort.get("selection_id") == catalog_selection_id
                        and cohort.get("resolved_count") == len(selected)
                        and not cohort.get("include_ids") and not cohort.get("exclude_ids"),
                        "The saved original portfolio lost its exact retained cohort.")
                report["saved_catalog_selection"] = cohort
            portfolio = page.locator('[aria-label="Saved portfolio"]')
            expect(portfolio).to_be_visible()
            expect(portfolio.get_by_role("heading", name=TITLE, exact=True)).to_be_visible()
            report["summary"] = saved["summary"]
            report["saved_visible_summary"] = portfolio.locator(".cons-summary").inner_text()
            photograph("03-saved-portfolio.png")

            page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded")
            expect(page.locator("#conservation-workspace")).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('[data-action="conservation-open-plan"][data-plan-id=' +
                         json.dumps(plan_id) + "]").click()
            expect(page.locator('[aria-label="Saved portfolio"]')).to_be_visible()
            reopened = get("/api/conservation/plan", plan_id=plan_id)
            require(reopened["id"] == saved["id"]
                    and reopened["selected_ids"] == saved["selected_ids"]
                    and reopened["selection"] == saved["selection"]
                    and reopened["summary"] == saved["summary"],
                    "Reopened portfolio identity, selection or quantities changed.")
            report["reopened_plan_id"] = reopened["id"]
            report["reopened_selection_matches"] = True
            report["reopened_visible_summary"] = page.locator(
                '[aria-label="Saved portfolio"] .cons-summary').inner_text()
            require(report["saved_visible_summary"] == report["reopened_visible_summary"],
                    "Saved and reopened visible totals differ.")
            photograph("04-reopened.png")

            export_task = action(page.locator('[data-action="conservation-export-plan"]'),
                                 "conservation.export", "export")
            descriptor = export_task["result"]
            tickets = [item for item in export_task.get("_downloads", [])
                       if item.get("sha256") == descriptor.get("sha256")
                       and str(item.get("filename", "")).endswith(".zip")]
            require(len(tickets) == 1, "The completed export needs its original ZIP download ticket.")
            ticket = tickets[0]
            if not page.locator("#detail-dialog[open]").count():
                task_id = report["task_ids"]["export"]
                button = page.locator('[data-action="task-open"][data-id=' + json.dumps(task_id) + "]")
                if not button.is_visible():
                    page.locator('.top-actions [data-action="tasks"]').click()
                expect(button).to_be_visible()
                button.click()
            download_link = page.locator("#detail-dialog a[href=" +
                                         json.dumps(ticket["url"] + "?download=1") + "]")
            expect(download_link).to_be_visible()
            packet_path = output / "portfolio-packet.zip"
            with page.expect_download() as pending:
                download_link.click()
            download = pending.value
            require(download.failure() is None, "The browser export download failed.")
            download.save_as(str(packet_path))
            actual = file_record(packet_path)
            require(actual["bytes"] == descriptor["bytes"]
                    and actual["sha256"] == descriptor["sha256"],
                    "The browser download differs from the original exported packet.")
            with zipfile.ZipFile(packet_path) as archive:
                require(archive.testzip() is None, "A downloaded packet member failed its CRC check.")
                members = [{"path": item.filename, "bytes": item.file_size}
                           for item in archive.infolist() if not item.is_dir()]
            report["packet"] = {**actual, "members": members}
            report["page_errors"] = list(dict.fromkeys(report["page_errors"]))
            report["console_errors"] = list(dict.fromkeys(report["console_errors"]))
            require(not report["page_errors"], "The browser reported a JavaScript error; inspect receiving.json.")
            report["state"] = "complete"
            report["completed_at"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
            persist()
        except Exception as error:
            report["state"] = "failed"
            report["error"] = clean(type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
            try:
                photograph("failure.png")
            except Exception:
                pass
            persist()
            raise RuntimeError(report["error"]) from None
        finally:
            context.close()
            if video:
                report["video"] = file_record(video.path())
                persist()
            browser.close()
    say()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Reopen the complete scientific application

The scientific workspace archive carries its retained workspace and the installed application. The receiving directory has two siblings: `application/` and `workspace/`. Launch the received application's own server with the received workspace, so its saved investigations, scenarios and scientific results use the same supplied modules.

## Capture and reopen

Run the existing workspace commands from the installed application's directory:

```sh
python -B -m model.cli --workspace /ABSOLUTE/WORKSPACE backup /ABSOLUTE/DELIVERY/workspace.zip
python -B -m model.cli restore /ABSOLUTE/DELIVERY/workspace.zip /ABSOLUTE/RECEIVED
python -B /ABSOLUTE/RECEIVED/application/model/cli.py --workspace /ABSOLUTE/RECEIVED/workspace overview
python -B /ABSOLUTE/RECEIVED/application/operator/server.py --workspace /ABSOLUTE/RECEIVED/workspace
```

The operator prints the local address to open. Use its workspace selector to confirm the original project, select a saved programme or investigation, inspect a saved result, and continue work. The original source, grid, run, comparison and project identities remain in the archive.

## Application components

Capture includes the core model and operator, source tools and source material, shared run reuse modules, singular `integration/` and plural `integrations/` packages, `eco_intelligence/`, the installed documentation, receiving tools and supporting command-line tools. Existing top-level setup scripts and environment requirements are retained. Optional components are included when installed; capture does not download a different application edition.

Python bytecode, package caches, active lock files and temporary native recovery reserves are omitted. Ordinary application source is checked again before publication so an installation changing during capture cannot silently produce a mixed application.

## Saved database state

The project-local investigation database at `workspace/intelligence/investigations.sqlite3` is captured with SQLite's online backup API after opening a read transaction. This includes committed transactions still in a write-ahead log. Each archived database opens independently; its live WAL, shared-memory and rollback-journal companions are omitted.

The archive manifest's `database_snapshots` records identify these captures. The database is transactionally consistent at its capture point. The existing workspace lock also coordinates the product's ProjectStore writes. A persistently locked database reports its capture error without retaining archive locks indefinitely; a large snapshot that is making progress has no total-duration cutoff. A concurrent application installation or a replaced database causes capture to stop with its specific source path.

Content-addressed source objects, source editions, model runs, grids, delivery products, GeoPackages and unknown SQLite files retain their original bytes. Their checksums and scientific identities keep their existing meaning.

## Existing archives

The archive format remains `upstate.scientific-workspace-archive/v1`. Earlier archives without database snapshot records still open through the same restore command. Explicit archive inspection verifies each member against its retained length and SHA-256. Restore checks the complete manifest first, then verifies each member while extracting it, so large rasters do not need an extra decompression pass. Completed native result descriptors are bound to those verified member hashes and lengths. Saved scientific selections and their existing receiving validators are retained.

Receiving reads from one opened archive edition and records its SHA-256 before publishing the new directory. An archive that changes in place during receiving stops the operation and removes its owned staging directory. Capture also records the finished archive's identity before publication. Restore publishes into a new receiving directory and preserves existing destinations.

## Resume the same completed receiving task

Receiving now publishes `receiving-complete.json` beside `application/` and
`workspace/` in the same final directory rename. The record retains the complete
original result: the archive, project, destination and selection; original
database and acquisition records; implementation and parameter-study metadata;
saved source-context bindings; and the received delivery/navigation paths.
An interruption after that rename but before the operator saves its task result
therefore resumes the original receiving operation.

The maintained Python continuation is:

```python
from model import portable

result = portable.resume_restore(
    original_archive, original_receiving_directory,
    expected_archive_sha256=original_upload_sha256,
)
```

Use the same task, archive and destination. The optional expected digest is the
original upload or saved archive descriptor. The helper checks the original
archive and complete result binding, current project identity and destination.
It returns the original complete result with `reused_completed_output: true`.
It does not restore over the receiver, rerun a model, regenerate a report or
discard receiver-only edits. The ordinary `restore` command continues to require
a new destination; callers explicitly select the continuation helper when the
original receiving directory is already present.

For earlier receiving directories without this record, continuation first
verifies the original archive and all original received members. It recognizes
the specific saved delivery registration made by native receiving: the original
selection, fields and files, the same retained enclosing archive, and the
additive received-navigation inventory and its verified file descriptors.
Original completed delivery records remain unchanged. It applies the same
native Workspace, source, implementation, parameter-study and source-context
validators used during first receiving, then saves the recovered complete
result. Unrelated changes to an older unrecorded original member produce its
specific conflict instead of overwriting work. New recorded receiving can
resume acknowledgment after later receiver edits because its original complete
receive result was already preserved at publication.

Completed scientific report continuation composes with this archive step:
reuse the original saved preview/edition/task through the maintained
`source/observed-report-20261013/receive_operator.py` and
`model.scientific_report_editions`. Installing current rendering source does
not replace a completed original report or its selected sources. Explicitly
request a new report edition when a changed rendering is intended.

## Inspect the exact outgoing product

The producing peer opens and looks at the exact outgoing populated application
and its actual PDF/HTML reports before declaring the delivery ready. Operate the
important controls, selected-source/report views, downloads, complete archive
receiving and reopened receiver; check the actual screenshare width and relevant
narrow width (including 390 px). Inspect available empty, loading and error
states. View the real screens or captured screenshots yourself, repair clipping,
overflow, unreadable tables or broken controls, and retain the original source,
study and task identities. Use plain industrial layout and focused corrections.
Code inspection and successful HTTP or native execution do not replace this
actual rendered-product inspection. These are the owner's October 13 instructions,
as persisted in the application's current owner-directed inspection guides.

For the completed SOL13/7b7a lake-arm course, keep the original project beginning `99ae4422`,
edition `d2f1e12f9194b9a881253542f0b9a714205bec533b750ceac88e790416b1fb04`
and the original 600,289-byte archive with SHA-256
`6088fcae75b19ec2066ff524bb7209088295d2933b3cef71f836edbaeab52d7b`.
Adopt continuation at its current source boundary, reopen that original completed
result and preserve the receiver-only note; the original producing/Integration
owner retains its 390 px presentation fix and final rendered review.

# Scientific delivery report

The scientific report presents current physical exports, native scenario changes,
profile settings and original biophysical coefficients, receiving-water quantities and observation comparisons as
readable tables. PDF, offline HTML and Markdown share the same ordered report blocks.
The structured report companion retains those exact blocks, full source editions
and the selected original record IDs.

## Scientific data contract

The formatter consumes the existing completed Workspace records. It does not
calculate new model results or choose scenarios.

- Current quantities use each original artifact's sum, sum_units, valid_cells and
  pixel_area_ha. Nitrogen and phosphorus totals are kg/year; sediment totals are
  metric tonnes/year. The table reports the corresponding valid-cell support.
- Scenario changes use comparison.alternatives[].artifacts[pollutant].sum_change.
  This is the original alternative-minus-baseline sum over paired valid pixels.
  The displayed paired count comes from the same artifact. Full baseline and
  alternative totals with different footprints are never subtracted.
- A zero or absent valid-cell count produces an unavailable quantity. The native
  difference accumulator can equal zero when no cells are shared; that state is
  distinct from a supported zero net change.
- Original land-cover patches and native stages.landcover.edits appear together.
  Planned source masks and code changes retain their reasons; patch-cell and
  patch-hectare counts come from the completed native stage in declared order.
  When a destination code is also in from_codes, the original native counter can
  include cells already at that destination. Overlapping patches can recount a
  cell. These counters are therefore not labeled as the final net changed area.
- Observation metrics retain n, unique catchments, original annual periods,
  physical-unit RMSE and model-minus-observed bias. NSE remains dimensionless.
  All selected per-catchment comparisons retain observed, modeled and residual
  values plus their coverage status. Repeated source periods keep their original
  descriptive interpretation. A separate coverage table retains actual export cells,
  structural stream omissions, unexpected missing cells, outside-raster area and
  original coverage findings. Original annual-reference values, source units,
  row-specific methods, qualifiers, uncertainty and references remain visible.
- Receiving-water rows retain their exact contribution relationship, geographic
  area, quantity scope, source designation, paired support and positive increase
  and avoided-export components. Per-receptor overlap is explained alongside
  the quantities. Native family_union baseline and alternative totals appear as
  unduplicated tables using families[family].baseline_physical and
  families[family].alternatives[run_id].metrics; receptors are never summed to
  manufacture these totals. Different families can overlap. The original
  change-statistic sum_basis remains visible: net changes sum the stored Float32
  difference pixels, while increased and avoided components retain native
  Float64 paired-difference sums. Their small rounding differences are preserved.

The pinned [InVEST 3.20 NDR guide](https://storage.googleapis.com/releases.naturalcapitalproject.org/invest/3.20.0/userguide/en/ndr.html)
defines the native export rasters in kg/hectare/year. The pinned
[SDR guide](https://storage.googleapis.com/releases.naturalcapitalproject.org/invest/3.20.0/userguide/en/sdr.html)
defines sediment export density in metric tons/hectare/year. The existing native
adapter multiplies those rates by actual pixel area once. This formatter consumes
its retained mass artifacts and preserves their units.

## Original biophysical coefficients

The coefficient addition from edition v5 reads the saved profile's original CSV through Workspace.source_file,
then checks its exact body SHA256 against profile.table_summary.sha256. It uses
profiles.inspect_table with the saved profile's selected native models, preserving
the native validation and the source row order. table_summary.rows is a count;
the report obtains actual coefficients from the original CSV.

The selected-profile section includes the profile ID, selected models, source
collection and source ID, original edition/reference/filename/hash, and complete
row/column counts. Separate nitrogen, phosphorus and sediment tables preserve
original source strings and every land-cover code. Nitrogen and phosphorus loads
retain their per-row load_type_n/load_type_p choices. Additional original fields,
including land-cover descriptions and source citations, appear in a separate
three-column table. No coefficient row is truncated or sampled.

The pinned NDR definitions label loads as kg/ha/year, critical lengths as metres,
and efficiencies/subsurface shares as fractions. The original application-rate
value stays visible; the report explains the native load * (1 - eff) adjustment
and the direct measured-runoff interpretation without recomputing results. SDR C
and P are dimensionless. The l_max algorithm setting is the maximum dimensionless
USLE L factor, corrected from the earlier metre label.

Normalization tables also display the original recorded cap units, reference,
scope and comparison description when the retained priority record supplies them.

The public refine_sections interface is unchanged. The formatter already receives
workspace and profile; edition v6 retains the complete original table and composes
the economic link and Markdown additions onto those coefficient tables.
The existing delivery REPORT_VERSION binding gives this combined v6 report a distinct
edition while earlier complete reports remain reproducible.

## Integrate in the maintained delivery

Receive the current complete application through its existing cumulative receiving
operation. The scientific report now depends on the maintained delivery builder,
observed-source collector and figure renderer, annual-comparison diagnostics,
economic collector, client companion, archive capture and ordinary operator
preview controls. The application catalogue and its dependency closure retain
these modules together. Use `integration/application_components.json` with the
current source assembler and installer; carry the whole selected application
edition into the existing Workspace operation.

Updating only an old formatter and its guide is insufficient for the current
report. Earlier integration examples belonged to their original editions. The
current delivery already contains the calls below; preserve those maintained
calls when composing another component, and apply source changes to their current
implementations.

The maintained flow is:

1. Validate the original baseline, ordered alternatives, selected grid/profile,
   delivery mode, source selections and optional economic/native report bindings.
   Bind the selected observed-context source before computing delivery identity.
   Scientific renderer, client companion and application editions remain explicit.
2. Collect receiving-water quantities and their original map/source assets once.
   Collect the selected observed report, all source companions, concentration
   support and original figure specifications. Verify their saved binding before
   adding them to the report and retained file inventory.
3. Refine the existing ordered scientific sections with
   `scientific_report.refine_sections`. This reads the original biophysical CSV,
   completed native quantities and original annual comparison rows. The current
   `model/observation_diagnostics.py` reader adds exact-period and catchment-weight
   tables from those comparison rows. Append the maintained receiving-water and
   selected source/economic sections through their existing collectors.
4. Write `report.pdf`, `report.html`, `report.md` and `report-data.json` from the
   same ordered scientific blocks. Write the separate `client-report.*`
   companion through its maintained compiler. Register every returned descriptor
   and selected source/analysis asset in the existing delivery state.
5. Build the final offline atlas and `delivery.json` from that complete inventory.
   Their working-project links use the fixed package-relative
   `working/scientific-workspace.zip` path. Capture the final report, atlas,
   manifest and source descriptors in that scientific Workspace archive.
6. Verify the actual retained working archive, then build the complete delivery
   package. The receiver restores the original project, native records and
   captured delivery files through the existing portable Workspace operation.

This order keeps the original reports and navigation in the editable project.
The archive is retained beside its received files without requiring the ZIP to
contain its own checksum. A prior archive with different selected assets remains
retained as an earlier capture.

The report block contract remains ordered heading/block pairs. Table blocks have
`kind=table`, `columns`, `rows`, optional relative `widths` and a `caption`.
Link blocks retain package-relative files or supported original publisher links.
Figure blocks retain the complete original numeric specification and verified
SVG descriptor. The PDF, HTML, Markdown and data writers consume those same
blocks; the normal delivery stores their descriptor keys as `report`,
`report_html`, `report_markdown` and `report_data`.

For the operator's complete selection and archive controls, use
[Client report and selected-zone economics](CLIENT_REPORT.md).
For annual-reference weighting, original cohort membership and JSON export, use
[Annual-load comparison review](OBSERVATION_DIAGNOSTICS.md).
For received projects and retained original versus derived navigation, use
[Reopen a scientific delivery](RECEIVED_DELIVERY_NAVIGATION.md).

## Revising an original native-study delivery

Use **Revise delivery choices** from the existing delivery. The form displays the
retained study title, purpose and reference and carries the same
`delivery_mode: native_study` and `native_study` metadata into the new selection.
Its original native baseline, alternatives, attached analysis, saved report and
economic edition remain connected through their existing selectors and bindings.

Regional supporting sources and source-water overlays are optional for this mode.
An existing selected source stays selected; disabling one removes only that
optional selection. Native-study contact metadata can be left empty. The regional
delivery form continues to require its regional source editions, water-designation
overlays and contact fields. Both modes use the existing completed NDR and SDR
cohort contract.

The ordered retained-study selector carries each selected original report,
figures, measurements and source files in the chosen order. Rebuilding then uses
the maintained delivery pipeline described above to produce the current scientific
and client companions, final atlas and editable Workspace snapshot together.

## Open, print and reopen

report.pdf uses the existing ReportLab dependency, repeating table headers and
page-aware rows. report.html is self-contained, has a linked section index,
supports narrow screens and prints with repeating table headers. It requires no
network or browser script. report-data.json retains the displayed section
structure and full selection/source binding. report.md preserves the same complete
ordered sections, coefficient tables and relative links as readable Markdown. All four belong in the original
delivery archive and normal authenticated file inventory.

Receive this module in the complete application, compose the hooks above, and
open the current completed native delivery through the existing operator.
Inspect its PDF and offline HTML scenario-change tables, receive the full archive,
then reopen the same Workspace and report IDs. The actual native rendering and
reopening operation uses the existing completed model outputs.


## Inspect the actual outgoing report and application

Before presenting a client-facing report or application edition as ready, the
producing peer opens and visually inspects that exact outgoing edition. This is
Bryce's product-delivery instruction, recorded in the original Ecosystem thread
on 13 October 2026 at
[04:51 EDT](https://tokenjunkielabs.slack.com/archives/C0BTTA66TK3/p1791881463183449).
Keep this step in the current build and receiving instructions supplied to each
worker.

Use the original populated Workspace and selected report. Open the generated PDF
and offline HTML, look at their actual pages or screenshots, and follow the
important source and report links. Inspect the full coefficient and observation
tables, original units and qualifiers, numeric coordinates, figure labels and
captions, repeated panel headings and continued rows. Long source identities
must remain accessible without displacing the scientific content. Preserve the
plain industrial design: readable tables, consistent typography and spacing,
clear hierarchy and restrained controls.

In the normal operator, exercise the controls used for the outgoing course:
select or revise the retained study, reopen the saved report, download its
original files and archive, and receive/reopen the same selected project. Inspect
the actual screenshare width and a narrow width, including 390 pixels where the
current receiving course uses it. Check the relevant populated, empty, loading
and error states. Keep full hashes and source labels readable within their
containers; horizontal table scrolling should stay inside the table rather than
widening the whole page. For PDF and print, examine actual rendered pages for
clipped values, broken links, cramped panels and unreadable continuation rows.

Fix concrete visual or control failures in the maintained source and inspect the
resulting outgoing edition before presenting it. Source review, HTTP responses,
DOM counts and unviewed screenshots do not replace this direct product review.
Continue the existing rendering and receiving operation, preserving original
report identities and archives; the review should lead to useful repairs rather
than repeated broad tests or a separate verification product.

## Combined economic links and coefficient source

Edition v6 is the complete three-way composition of the common 31,003-byte v4
formatter, ASTRA13's 35,965-byte coefficient successor and the economic team's
33,787-byte link/Markdown successor. The coefficient and rendering additions are
disjoint; both source implementations are retained, with a new shared report
version. The original quantity, paired-support and family-union calculations
remain unchanged.

The existing client_economics collector supplies selected economic edition blocks
and original retained member paths. PDF and offline HTML render those package-relative
links directly; Markdown includes the same paths and source labels. The formatter
validates that link targets stay relative to the delivered package. The maintained
delivery integration retains each economic source member, edition record and ZIP,
and includes report_markdown in its original asset manifest.

Receiving uses the existing native report operation: compile the composed module,
open the current source-bound delivery, follow an economic link from its PDF or
HTML, compare its coefficient tables with the exact saved profile CSV, and reopen
the complete archive. The same ordered report blocks drive each output format.


## Linked sources and economic coverage (v7)

The report now preserves typed links for original publisher references, estimate sources, native-model guides and retained working materials. PDF, HTML, Markdown and structured report data use the same link labels and targets. Relative file links remain inside the extracted delivery; preserve its directory structure. Unknown or unsupported URI schemes remain readable text.

The selected economic edition supplies its original reporting-zone identity, modeled and unmodeled responses, available and unavailable alternatives, estimate dates and original common-support coverage. Each coverage percentage uses its own recorded valid-cell denominator, not the whole watershed area. Operating and annualized costs are reported per year in the recorded currency. The formatter reads the completed edition and does not recalculate costs or physical quantities.

The report uses the fixed package-relative working-project link during composition. The current builder captures the scientific workspace after both complete report sets, the final offline atlas and delivery manifest are retained. The current-export reference must be an original baseline scenario; future alternatives must be distinct and exclude that baseline. Scenario-analysis release readiness applies the same baseline requirement before opening the delivery form.

## Observed source context and original figures

Edition v8 composes the project's observed source context with the current maintained report, including its economic coverage and native-grid delivery sections.
The original parameter tables, native model quantities, receiving-water sections,
completed analysis, economic links and atlas assets remain in this formatter.

Select `source_roles.OBSERVED_CONTEXT` as an ordinary imported source choice:

```json
{"source_collection_id":"ACTUAL_COLLECTION_ID","source_id":"ACTUAL_CONTEXT_SOURCE_ID"}
```

The maintained `model.observed_context.bind(workspace, selection)` resolves the
original source and returns its stable binding before delivery identity is computed.
The delivery retains it as `selection.observed_context_binding`.
`observed_context.collect(workspace, selection, directory, state)` returns either
None when unselected or a dictionary with `sections`, `binding`, and `files`.
Its binding must equal the prior bound identity. Its files map contains ordinary
relative-path/bytes/SHA256 descriptors. The delivery verifies and retains all of
them under its observed_context file keys, includes their paths in project_assets,
and places the exact binding in report-data.json. This carries original source
tables and figure assets through the existing package and archive operation.

Observed concentrations, hydrology and discharge-source tables enter descriptive
context sections. The separate annual-load comparison hook continues to consume
only completed Workspace observation-comparison records bound to selected model
runs. The context producer uses the original units, periods, qualifiers and
contributing-area relationships for each data product.

### Figure block

A figure is an ordered report block with this shape:

```json
{
  "kind": "figure",
  "path": "observed-context/figures/original-figure.svg",
  "title": "Original source figure",
  "caption": "The source interpretation, units and period.",
  "alt": "A concise description of the plotted observations.",
  "bytes": 123,
  "sha256": "ACTUAL_64_CHARACTER_LOWERCASE_SHA256",
  "spec": {"original": "complete numeric figure specification"}
}
```

The values above illustrate field names; the observed-context producer supplies
actual retained bytes, hash and complete original numeric specification. Caption,
alt text, positive byte length and SHA256 are required. Paths stay relative to the
delivery and select the retained SVG. Both PDF and companion rendering verify the
SVG against its descriptor before producing outputs.

PDF calls the maintained `scientific_figures.panel_drawings(spec, width)` and
places its ReportLab vector drawings with the original title and caption. The
numeric specification retains original axes, tick labels, series and panel data.
It supports the maintained line, scatter and boxplot figures, including open
markers and the source's minimum/q1/median/q3/maximum/mean fields.
HTML embeds the verified original SVG bytes in each image's data URL, so opening
the HTML by itself does not require authenticated image requests or a neighboring
asset folder. Markdown links to the original package-relative SVG. Structured
report data retains the entire figure block and numeric specification. No extra SVG-conversion dependency
is introduced.

The producer and numeric drawing module are part of this same source contribution:
`model/observed_context.py` and `model/scientific_figures.py`. Install them with
the current formatter/delivery successor before invoking the original delivery.
The existing native receiving operation should render every figure declared by the selected original
recipe, open PDF and offline HTML, and retain their complete source context and
package with the selected original Workspace.


The combined v8 formatter preserves the current v7 source, coefficient, economic and delivery coverage tables. It verifies each retained SVG against its byte length and SHA256 before PDF or companion generation. PDF panels retain the supplied numeric coordinates and units; the offline HTML carries the exact SVG bytes and Markdown resolves the original SVG through its package-relative path. The observed context is bound before delivery identity is computed and every retained companion is included in the original package asset inventory.

## Self-contained scientific HTML figures (v10)

The HTML writer verifies the resolved SVG remains inside the delivery directory,
then reads its original bytes once and checks their byte length and SHA256 against
the figure descriptor before encoding them. Its image data URLs are derived only
for HTML rendering. The ordered report blocks retain their original paths, hashes,
source specifications, captions and alt text, and every original SVG remains an
ordinary retained package asset. PDF drawings, Markdown links and report-data JSON
continue to use the original figure contract. The report version changes the
normal delivery identity so a completed older report can be regenerated with this
self-contained image representation through the existing selection workflow.


## Original observation context, native footprints and readable PDF tables (v15)

The annual-comparison chapter now displays the retained contextual source rows
alongside its original admitted catchment comparisons. Point-source discharge
